Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge is working with the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and The Arunachal State Rural Livelihoods Mission (ArSRLM), to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting ultra poor and most vulnerable households. The Arunachal Pradesh Economic Inclusion Program (ArEIP) is a targeted poverty alleviation initiative aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of rural households experiencing extreme vulnerability in Arunachal Pradesh. The program primarily focuses on distressed single and young mothers, along with other poorest-of-the-poor households, with a strong emphasis on strengthening women s economic and social inclusion. The initiative seeks to support approximately 20,000 vulnerable households across selected blocks and districts of the state.


What will you do
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the District and Block professionals for effective and timely implementation of SAY
Manage District and Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of District and Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge s financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the ArSRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support ArSRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the ultra-poor through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the NRLM
Support ArSRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in ultra-poverty out of it
Support ArSRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Jharkhand such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the ultra-poor.


Who are we looking for in this role
About 8-10 years of experience and is a Postgraduate.
Have experienced in Program Implementation and leading teams
Demonstrated a growth mindset - learning/improving constantly
Demonstrated success in starting and leading initiatives, working under uncertainty able to articulate vision and secure buy-in from stakeholders
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills. Fluent in English local language
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Has the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholder groups/ State Officials in a fast-paced environment
Set aside personal bias to do what is right for the community
Experience in designing/managing multi-stakeholder development sector programs designed around (or with) SHGs, Community Institutions and ArSRLM
An openness to travel extensively as per the needs of the program s goals
A passion for serving those in need with humility sensitivity

Ability to deliver 5 star culinary products.
Experience in high volume operation of at least 500 meals per service.
Extensive kitchen machinery and knife safety knowledge.
Experience working in all major culinary brigade stations with extensive knowledge in designated station.

Responsible for directing, supervising and assisting in the preparation of all food in the assigned station in the kitchen in accordance with the established company menus and recipes.

Works closely and cooperates with superiors, colleagues and subordinates in order to achieve the highest possible guest satisfaction from the products served.
Prepares a daily requisition for Executive Chef for all items ordered from stores for use in his station.
Execute all special orders and dietary requirements.
Responsible for helping to maintain a team atmosphere in the department.

Responsible to implement and execute proper maintenance and cleaning procedures in the station assigned to him in order to ensure good appearance and condition of these areas.
Reports any malfunctioning equipment or furnishings in need of repair or refurbishing to the Executive Sous Chef supervising his station.
Maintains a high level of productivity, cleanliness and sanitation throughout the entire station.
Responsible for ensuring that proper work and cleaning methods are being followed in order to produce and serve safe, wholesome, high quality and attractive food for guests and crew.
Responsible for the proper use of equipment and utensils to prevent damage or undue maintenance requirements. Report to have replaced.
Assigns all cleaning responsibilities within his station according to the cleaning schedule and report to the Executive Sous Chef regarding any problems, which have occurred. If station has GPA personnel assigned, he is responsible for his performance.
To be familiar with and execute the Seabourn HESS-MS appropriate to their position.
Assists the Sushi Chef de Cuisine in the preparation of various Sushi products in the speciality restaurant.

The Chef de Partie is required to adopt a pro-active approach in solving challenges that may arise in their station. Guest satisfaction is the ultimate goal and the Chef de Partie should ensure that all decisions made have the guest in mind. Assisting teammates plays an integral role in this position and they should therefor encourage and coach those that work with him.

Reporting Relationships:
The Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Cuisine.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Company Description

Simplilearn is a leading digital skills training platform that helps individuals and organizations build capabilities needed to succeed in the digital economy. The company offers rigorous online programs in rapidly evolving fields such as Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Digital Marketing, and Data Science. Courses and certifications are designed and continuously updated by more than 2,000 industry and academic experts, and delivered in partnership with world-renowned universities. Simplilearn focuses on practical, applied learning through thousands of live classes each month and real-world projects, enabling millions of professionals to gain work-ready skills and supporting organizations with corporate training and employee upskilling. This learner-centric approach has helped a majority of participants achieve promotions or new roles in their careers.

Role Description:
The Student Advisor (Sales) will support prospective learners through the entire admission and enrollment journey, with a focus on consultative selling and student guidance. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with leads via calls, emails, and messages, understanding learners goals, recommending suitable programs, and clearly explaining course features, pricing, and outcomes. The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, following up on inquiries, meeting enrollment and revenue targets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve learner experience. Student Advisors will also provide basic counseling on career paths, program selection, and learning formats while ensuring high-quality customer service. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bangalore Urban.

QualificationsCandidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and customer service skills to build trust, handle queries, and manage learner relationships effectively.
Candidates should possess student counseling skills and education-related understanding to guide learners on program selection and career pathways.
Candidates should possess clear and confident communication skills, including spoken and written English, to conduct professional sales and advisory conversations.
Candidates should possess basic sales, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, with a track record of meeting targets in inside sales or similar roles.
Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with CRM tools, comfort with night/US shifts, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

About the job

Company Description Simplilearn is a leading digital skills training platform that helps individuals and organizations build capabilities needed to succeed in the digital economy. The company offers rigorous online programs in rapidly evolving fields such as Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Digital Marketing, and Data Science. Courses and certifications are designed and continuously updated by more than 2,000 industry and academic experts, and delivered in partnership with world-renowned universities. Simplilearn focuses on practical, applied learning through thousands of live classes each month and real-world projects, enabling millions of professionals to gain work-ready skills and supporting organizations with corporate training and employee upskilling. This learner-centric approach has helped a majority of participants achieve promotions or new roles in their careers.
Role Description:
The Student Advisor (Sales) will support prospective learners through the entire admission and enrollment journey, with a focus on consultative selling and student guidance. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with leads via calls, emails, and messages, understanding learners goals, recommending suitable programs, and clearly explaining course features, pricing, and outcomes. The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, following up on inquiries, meeting enrollment and revenue targets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve learner experience. Student Advisors will also provide basic counseling on career paths, program selection, and learning formats while ensuring high-quality customer service. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bangalore Urban.
QualificationsCandidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and customer service skills to build trust, handle queries, and manage learner relationships effectively.
Candidates should possess student counseling skills and education-related understanding to guide learners on program selection and career pathways.
Candidates should possess clear and confident communication skills, including spoken and written English, to conduct professional sales and advisory conversations.
Candidates should possess basic sales, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, with a track record of meeting targets in inside sales or similar roles.
Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with CRM tools, comfort with night/US shifts, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Regards
Mohit Kumar
Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition

Self-driven, goal-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
Familiarity with CRM tool - Salesforce is an added advantage.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts/weekends (as required for B2C audiences).

What We Offer
Competitive fixed pay plus interesting performance incentives.
Rapid career growth in a global EdTech leader.
Learning & development support with access to all Simplilearn programs.
Dynamic, high-energy work culture with strong peer support.

- Good communication skills

Principal Responsibilities

About the Role
Are you passionate about helping customers and providing excellent service? About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is India's first PropTech unicorn. Specific Responsibilities
Customer Support: Handle inbound and outbound customer calls and assist customers with their queries and concerns.
Query Resolution: Understand customer issues and provide accurate, timely, and effective solutions.
Customer Relationship Management: Build positive customer relationships through professional and courteous communication.
Service Excellence: Ensure a smooth customer experience while maintaining high service quality standards.
Follow-ups: Contact customers when required to provide updates, resolve pending queries, and ensure customer satisfaction.
Issue Escalation: Identify complex issues and escalate them to the appropriate team for resolution.
Customer Feedback: Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall service experience.
Performance Goals: Meet defined targets related to call quality, customer satisfaction, productivity, and resolution time.
Documentation: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, queries, and resolutions in the company's systems.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers
Education: HSC (12th pass) or graduate candidates can apply.
Communication Skills: Good verbal communication and active listening skills.
Language Requirements: Candidates must be proficient in English and Hindi, along with one of the following regional languages:
Profile 1: English + Hindi + Kannada
Profile 2: English + Hindi + Telugu
Customer Service Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, patience, empathy, and a customer-first attitude.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to handle customer queries professionally and maintain positive customer relationships.
Technical Skills: Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office are preferred.
Work Schedule: Comfortable working 6 days a week, with one weekday off.
Shift Timing: Flexible to work a 9-hour shift scheduled between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM.
Perks & Value Proposition
Health Insurance: Company-paid health insurance coverage of 1 lakh per year.
Career Growth: Opportunities for internal career progression based on performance.
Promotions: Regular performance reviews, with promotions every six months and accelerated opportunities for outstanding performers, as per company policy.
Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Team-Building Activities: Regular team events and an annual outing.
Why NoBroker?
At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to grow professionally while delivering exceptional customer experiences. Join a collaborative and fast-paced work environment where your communication skills, customer-focused approach, and problem-solving abilities can make a real difference.
Apply today and take the next step in your career with NoBroker!

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Executive to manage and optimise paid marketing campaigns across Meta and Google Ads. Meta Ads

Job Title: Sales Manager
CompanyCredila Financial Services Limited
Location Aurangabad
DepartmentSales - Institutional Funding
TravelYes

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. This involves visiting and building a pipeline of prospective Institutional lending customers seeking loan for the purpose of Institutional development and meeting the channel partners on a regular basis.
Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.
2. Achieving the target assigned on a month-on-month basis.
3. Understanding the Customers loan requirement and helping them as a SPOC in the end-to-end loan journey from login to disbursement.
4. Coordinating with the customer/s or channel partners and collecting all the required documents mentioned in the policy to ensure a hassle-free loan approval process for the customer.
5. Meet the assigned Channel partners on a regular basis and generate leads/referrals for New Business Acquisition.
6. Maintaining high levels of integrity at all times while engaging with the prospective / existing customers, Channel partners and the various support teams (Credit, Operations, Service, legal etc) within Credila.
7. Training and supporting the Channel partners in understanding the process & policies, joint customer visits and timely release of payouts.
8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products

Required Skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and sales closing abilities.
Ability to build customer relationships over calls and virtual meetings.
Good lead generation and customer handling skills.
Target-oriented approach with a positive attitude.
Familiarity with CRM software and lead management.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Strong follow-up, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

Candidate Requirements
Any Graduate or Postgraduate preferred.
Candidates with a proven track record in sales and target achievement are preferred.
Experience in Inside Sales, Telesales, Telecalling, or Business Development will be an added advantage.
Should be comfortable with outbound calling and customer interactions.

Job Title Executive - Customer Service
Department Operations
Company Profile
Credence Global Solutions is a diversified technology-driven financial transformation company with deep
expertise and a focus on Receivables Management, Health care RCM, Technology Platforms and Contact
Center verticals. Credence services leading telecommunication, health care and media companies in the
United States.
We are 4600+ employees strong who provide exceptional performance that is customer friendly &
compliant; and deliver world-class results to ensure brand integrity.
Health care providers serviced by Credence include medical transport providers, emergency physicians,
health infusion service providers, and diagnostic laboratories.
In the telecommunication vertical, Credence serves four of the top five providers in the United States.


Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused individual to join our team in a collections role. As
part of our dynamic collections team, you will be responsible for managing customer accounts with
professionalism, ensuring timely resolution of delinquencies while maintaining strong customer
relationships. The ideal candidate will have a strong ability to handle difficult situations, demonstrate
problem-solving skills, and adhere to company policies and compliance regulations.
Job Roles & Responsibilities

As an Executive - Customer Service, you will be responsible to communicate with consumers of
healthcare and telecommunication providers in the United States to collect on overdue and unpaid
bills. As a collection specialist, you will be responsible for calling consumers on phone and
negotiating for the overdue payment, on behalf of the client.

Utilize effective verbal communication and customer service skills while communicating with
customers to resolve the account delinquency.

Able to manage difficult customer issues while working in a fast-paced environment
Determine the reason for delinquency and best course of action to assist consumers.
Engage our consumers with the highest level of respect and dignity.
Document all collection efforts for each assigned account in accordance with established procedures
and compliance policies.

Communicate professionally and regularly with leadership and peers on status of accounts,
escalations in accordance with established standards.

Ensure all accounts in assigned lists are managed accurately and in a timely manner.
Calls are majorly outbound and over a period moves to a blended (inbound/outbound) environment.
Accounts are early/mid/late - stage defaults return payments, first payment defaults, and work date
follow up assignments.
Profile Requirements

Good communication skills
This job requires you to work in US shifts between 5:30 pm & 10:30 am




Highlights

Best in Market Salaries from 3 lakhs plus
7 week new hire training program
Unlimited Incentive Plan with transparent KRA's
Enhance your Analytical/Decision Making & Negotiation skills
Cross functional growth opportunities within 6 months, for experienced candidates
Free Medical/Life insurance
Employee Centric & Compliant Policies
Free Home Pick & Drop Transportation
Fixed shifts post the training period [Rare changes in case of business requirements]
7:15 min login plus 45 minute break = 8 hour shifts
Sunday fixed Off & Alternate Saturday Working

Job Title Executive - Customer Service
Department Operations
Company Profile
Credence Global Solutions is a diversified technology-driven financial transformation company with deep
expertise and a focus on Receivables Management, Health care RCM, Technology Platforms and Contact
Center verticals. Credence services leading telecommunication, health care and media companies in the
United States.
We are 4600+ employees strong who provide exceptional performance that is customer friendly &
compliant; and deliver world-class results to ensure brand integrity.
Health care providers serviced by Credence include medical transport providers, emergency physicians,
health infusion service providers, and diagnostic laboratories.
In the telecommunication vertical, Credence serves four of the top five providers in the United States.



Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused individual to join our team in a collections role. As
part of our dynamic collections team, you will be responsible for managing customer accounts with
professionalism, ensuring timely resolution of delinquencies while maintaining strong customer
relationships. The ideal candidate will have a strong ability to handle difficult situations, demonstrate
problem-solving skills, and adhere to company policies and compliance regulations.
Job Roles & Responsibilities

As an Executive - Customer Service, you will be responsible to communicate with consumers of
healthcare and telecommunication providers in the United States to collect on overdue and unpaid
bills. As a collection specialist, you will be responsible for calling consumers on phone and
negotiating for the overdue payment, on behalf of the client.

Utilize effective verbal communication and customer service skills while communicating with
customers to resolve the account delinquency.

Able to manage difficult customer issues while working in a fast-paced environment
Determine the reason for delinquency and best course of action to assist consumers.
Engage our consumers with the highest level of respect and dignity.
Document all collection efforts for each assigned account in accordance with established procedures
and compliance policies.

Communicate professionally and regularly with leadership and peers on status of accounts,
escalations in accordance with established standards.

Ensure all accounts in assigned lists are managed accurately and in a timely manner.
Calls are majorly outbound and over a period moves to a blended (inbound/outbound) environment.
Accounts are early/mid/late - stage defaults return payments, first payment defaults, and work date
follow up assignments.
Profile Requirements

Good communication skills
This job requires you to work in US shifts between 5:30 pm & 10:30 am




Highlights

Best in Market Salaries from 3 lakhs plus
7 week new hire training program
Unlimited Incentive Plan with transparent KRA's
Enhance your Analytical/Decision Making & Negotiation skills
Cross functional growth opportunities within 6 months, for experienced candidates
Free Medical/Life insurance
Employee Centric & Compliant Policies
Free Home Pick & Drop Transportation
Fixed shifts post the training period [Rare changes in case of business requirements]
7:15 min login plus 45 minute break = 8 hour shifts
Sunday fixed Off & Alternate Saturday Working

Job Title
Kitchen Associate


Job Overview
As a Kitchen Associate, your main responsibility is to support daily kitchen operations. This includes keeping your station clean, following food safety rules, helping with basic prep work, and assisting in food preparation while maintaining good quality.Youll also help with sanitization and hygiene in the kitchen. Packing and dispatch may be done occasionally, only when required.


Store Operating Hours
7:00 AM to 3:00 AM


Working Shift Hours
Candidate must be open to working in break shifts, which run in 2 parts: Morning: 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM || Evening: 7:00 PM to 12:00 AM


Regular Shift Duration
10 hours


Key Responsibilities
Maintain kitchen hygiene and follow food safety rules.
Do mise-en-place prep and ensure quality before cooking.
Assist in cooking and assembling meals as per standards.
Support in packing dispatch only when needed.
Keep your station clean and hygienic.


Requirements
Minimum High school(10th) education with basic understanding of cutting and food preparation.
Physically fit and ready for working in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
Good hygiene, discipline, punctual, clean shaved and willingness to learn.
Must be flexible to do break shifts.
Able to follow instructions and work in a team.

Description:
Greetings from Wipro!!!

Wipro is conducting Walk-in Drive for Freshers - Associate- Risk & Fraud analyst role.

Required Skills:

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly document findings and decisions.
Excellent comprehension skills and the ability to interpret policies, procedures, and complex case scenarios accurately.
Understanding of online fraud, account security, identity verification, payment risk, platform abuse, and emerging digital threats.
Ability to make objective, policy-based decisions while handling sensitive content, user reports, and risk investigations.
Strong analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
High attention to detail with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and risk indicators across multiple data points.
Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools, workflow platforms, and technology-enabled investigation systems.
Strong internet research skills and familiarity with online marketplaces, digital platforms, social media ecosystems, and evolving internet culture.
Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy, productivity, and quality standards.
Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment both independently and as part of a team.
Adaptability to changing business requirements, policies, tools, and operational priorities.
Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with a collaborative mindset.
Basic understanding of data privacy, customer trust, platform integrity, and compliance principles.

Specifications:
Work location- Gopanpally, Hyderabad
Should be flexible to "Work from Office"
Should be flexible to work in Rotational shifts (Including night shifts)
Qualification- Graduation (should have all documents, PC & CMM Mandatory).
Pursuing candidates are not eligible (Graduation or post graduation)
Only Fresher's are eligible to apply
Need immediate joiners
Working days- 5 Days a week with 2 days of rotational week off.

Please carry below mandatory documents for the interview:-

1) Updated Resume
2) Recent Passport size photograph (taken in last 6months)
3) PAN Card & Aadhar card (Original is mandatory)
4) Provisional certificate of highest qualification (Graduation/ Post Graduation) issued by University.
Regards,
Wipro TA Team

Engagement Service Centres - Associate Senior Assistant
Position Summary
As an Associate Senior Assistant, you will support the audit team by performing a range of administrative tasks within the ESC group. Your responsibilities will include drafting engagement letters, monitoring audit client compliance with SEC independence rules and Deloitte policies and managing client acceptance and continuation processes. Additionally, you will coordinate group audits and provide support for various audit tools, such as audit confirmations, trial balance support, and financial statement tie-outs.
Work You'll Do
Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, with the ability to understand implications of findings, next steps, and project deadlines.
Follow the agreed process in the development of deliverables and adopt a structured approach.
Provide regular updates to team lead about the progress of assigned tasks.
Ensure the executed work meets the Firm's quality standards.
Should learn the various tools and templates used by ESCs.
Hiring location would be Hyderabad
The Team
Engagement Service Centres (ESCs) is a shared services group that provides dedicated administrative support to the Audit function. The group serves as hubs of skilled, dedicated resources who support engagement teams and work in multiple audit areas. Some services from this group include Engagement Letter ESC (ELESC), Client Acceptance ESC (CAESC), Digital Services COE and Independence Support ESC (ISESC). Activities performed by the ESC group are not audit-related.
Location : Hyderabad
Shift Time : 9 AM to 6 PM 
Qualifications
Required 
B.Com with 2-3 years of experience or MBA Finance with 0-1 year experience.
Should be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office products, especially Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel.
Preferred Qualifications
Should be self-motivated, with a results-oriented mindset and strong analytical skills. Must have problem-solving skills and the ability to learn quickly. High attention to
detail and the capacity to meet tight deadlines are required.
Should possess excellent written and oral communication skills, along with good interpersonal skills.
Should possess good interpretation skills to read, understand and apply rules, regulations, policies and procedures.

Description:
Client Service Executive Voice Process

Company: iEnergizer IT Services Pvt. Ltd.
Location: AKR Tech Park, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru
Salary: Up to 31,000 CTC per month
Experience: Freshers & Experienced
Education: Any Graduate
Process: Domestic Voice Process
Interview: Only One Round

Job Description

iEnergizer is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused individuals for the position of Client Service Executive Voice Process.

We are looking for candidates with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to interact professionally with customers.

This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates and experienced professionals looking to develop their careers in client servicing, customer experience, and business operations.

Roles & Responsibilities

- Handle customer interactions through voice calls.
- Understand client requirements and provide appropriate solutions.
- Assist customers with their queries and service-related concerns.
- Maintain professional communication and customer satisfaction.
- Coordinate with relevant teams whenever required.
- Follow process guidelines and maintain quality standards.

Candidate Requirements

- Any graduate can apply.
- Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.
- Excellent English communication is mandatory.
- Telugu, Kannada, or Malayalam communication skills.
- Good interpersonal and listening skills.
- Basic computer knowledge.
- Willingness to work from the office in Bengaluru.

What We Offer

- Salary up to 31,000 CTC per month. ( Fresher will be having different package)
- Opportunity for freshers to start their corporate careers.
- Professional working environment.
- Exposure to client servicing and voice operations.
- Simple one-round interview process.

Interview & Work Location

iEnergizer, 1st Floor, AKR Tech Park, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068.

HR Contact: 9036768850 / 9110470838
Email: sheeja.jose@ienergizer.com

Interested candidates can apply directly through Naukri or contact our HR team.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

Description:
Position Overview: As an individual contributor, you will play a pivotal role in improving EBITDA and profitability of the LTL business. You will need to possess a strong commercial sense, work well under pressure, be results-oriented and be able to independently drive large initiatives end to endconceptualisationon to execution). Your primary focus will be on analysing data, coming up with strategies based on the analysis, collaborating with cross-functional teams to finalise action plans & execute with speed.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Create & own client-level P&L by analysing billing data and costs from various sources and reconciling with the business-level P&L prepared by the Finance team.
2. Identify opportunities for gross margin improvement on a client level with a revised pricing proposal.
3. Collaborate closely with the Business Development team to track and execute pricing actions for gross margin improvement.
4. Forecasting: Enablegranular-levell forecasting of demand for LTL, for both existing & new clients.
5. Synthesise market intelligence data, propose changes to pricing strategy based on this.
6. Develop pricing strategies, build tools / enhance existing ones to drive improvement in profitability at a client level based on existing network load trends.
7. Solution building: Help the BD team cater to new client requirements and enable product teams to build the necessary features/capabilities through a framework to prioritise and pursue such efforts that will enable maximum benefit to the company.
8. Work in tandem with the Corporate Finance team to track cost drivers and evaluate cost-saving initiatives.
9. Provide regular updates to Senior Management on the progress of initiatives and competitor analysis in terms of pricing strategies.
10. Drive data-driven decision-making by presenting complex analyses in a simplified and
visually compelling manner to CXO-level stakeholders.
11. Continuously monitor and assess the effectiveness of implemented strategies, making
real-time adjustments as necessary to ensure goals are met.
12. Act as an individual contributor, taking ownership of projects from inception to completion and collaborating with cross-functional teams to execute initiatives.
13. Cultivate a culture of learning and innovation by staying updated on industry trends, new technologies, and best practices.
Qualifications:

1. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Economics (MBA preferred).
2. Relevant experience (3-5 years) in a strategic analytical role, preferably within the transportation, logistics, or supply chain industry.
3. Proficient in advanced Excel and Google Sheets.
4. Basic knowledge of SQL and Python is a plus.
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
6. Ability to work independently and deliver results under tight deadlines.
7. Excellent communication skills.
AboutCompany:
Brief-
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

An Executive - Operations is responsible for overseeing the day - to - day operations of a company to ensure efficiency, profitability, and growth. Strong leadership and problem - solving skills, as well as the ability to analyze data and make informed decisions, are essential for success in this role.

Team Leader
Position Title: Team Leader Airline Customer Operations Exp. Mandatory
Employment Type: Full-time
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Team Leader Airline Operations to oversee a high-performing team of travel consultants delivering end-to-end customer support for a major international airline account. The ideal candidate possesses deep subject-matter expertise in Global Distribution Systems (GDS) specifically Amadeus alongside hands-on mastery of New Distribution Capability (NDC) workflows. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, monitoring service
level agreements (SLAs), coaching frontline agents, and handling complex airline ticketing, reissuance, fare construction, and disruption management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Operational & SLA Management
Monitor live queue health, shrinkage, Average Handling Time (AHT), Abandonment Rate, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) to meet contractual airline SLAs.
Supervise real-time floor performance, schedule adherence, and agent occupancy across voice, email, and live chat channels. Act as the direct point of escalation for complex travel disruptions, irregular operations
(IROPS), schedule changes, involuntary reroutes, and complex reissues/refunds.
Drive operational compliance with airline-specific policies, debit memo (ADM) avoidance rules, and IATA ticketing regulations.
2. Technical Leadership (GDS & NDC)
Serve as the Team Lead for Amadeus GDS and modern NDC retailing platforms.
Guide team members through complex PNR servicing, fare quote recalculations, split ticketing, residual value computations (EMD-S / EMD-A issuance), and involuntary schedule disruption flows.
Ensure proper implementation and adherence to NDC-direct booking standards, API-integrated workflows, and airline loyalty program servicing. Audit ticketing entries to identify pattern errors and prevent Airline Debit Memos (ADMs).

3. People Management & Quality Coaching
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of 1520 customer care travel specialists.
Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions, performance evaluations, and root-cause analyses on quality scorecard audits (CSAT, DSAT, QA scores).
Partner with the Quality Assurance (QA) and Training teams to address knowledge gaps in GDS navigation, ticketing rules, and customer de-escalation.
Manage attendance, disciplinary actions, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and team attrition.
4. Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly operational KPI scorecards for internal management and airline client review.
Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend workflow automation or knowledge-base updates.
Facilitate weekly team huddles to cascade policy updates, fare rule changes, and seasonal airline operational directives.
Qualifications & Skills
Required Experience
Education: Bachelors degree in Travel & Tourism, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Work Experience:
Minimum of 2-3 years of total experience in international airline/travel BPO operations.
Overall experience 5-7 yrs
Amadeus GDS: Advanced command of Amadeus commands, cryptic and graphic interfaces, automated ticketing, exchanges (Amadeus Ticket Changer - ATC), manual re-pricing, and EMD issuance.
NDC Proficiency: Strong practical experience navigating airline NDC
portals/aggregators, servicing NDC orders, ancillary add-ons, and processing NDC-compliant voids/refunds. Aviation Knowledge: Strong foundation in IATA geography, fare construction rules,
MPM/routing principles, code-share agreements, baggage interline agreements, and Schengen/transit visa requirements.
Leadership & Soft Skills
Strong analytical ability to interpret operational scorecards, roster metrics, and CRM data.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; professional client-facing presence.
Proven conflict-resolution and de-escalation skills during crisis operations (weather grounding, system outages, schedule adjustments). Flexibility to work in 24/7 rotating shifts, including night shifts and public holidays.

Create Saint-Gobain culture by re-enforcing SG Purpose, PAPC, SG attitudes at the Workplace.
Drive HR Processes Human Resource Planning, People Capability Building through Recruitment, Learning & Development, ProSkills, SG Next Program, People experience projects, Diversity initiatives
Manage Employee Life Cycle for respective function - People Practices, People Engagement & Involvement creating positive experience, People Wellbeing
HR Policy administration, HR best practices benchmarking and HR Communication Effectiveness.
Capability Building and skills availability in the respective function.
ACTIVITIES AND END-PURPOSES
Strategic HR & Business Partnership
a. Act as the primary HR point of contact for Float Line leadership, aligning HR strategies with business goals (production targets, quality, and safety KPIs).
b. Translate business priorities into HR initiatives that support growth, operational excellence, and organizational culture
c. Participate in operational meetings to understand challenges and provide proactive HR solutions.
Talent Management & Workforce Planning
a. Lead workforce planning for Float Lines 4 & 6 — forecasting manpower needs based on shifts, production schedules, attrition, and future expansions.
b. Competency Management through ProSkill, identify gaps and operational capability needs; enable training plans to build required technical and behavioral capabilities.
c. Support succession planning for critical manufacturing/technical roles to prevent disruptions.
Training & Learning, Development
a. Drive the performance appraisal cycle, ensuring clear alignment on goals, KPIs, and development areas for float line workforce and supervisors.
b. Coach managers on performance conversations, performance improvement plans, promotion readiness, and objective setting.
c. Support ongoing learning & development initiatives — both technical training (e.g., safety, lean practices) and leadership capabilities.
d. Driving People Development pillar and Gender Diversity initiatives in the respective function.
e. Ensuring LWE system adherence and learning experience in the respective function.
Employee Relations & Engagement
a. Facilitate employee engagement programs focused on shop-floor culture, safety participation, recognition, and retention.
b. Promote an inclusive culture aligned with Saint-Gobain values — trust, empowerment, collaboration Support
c. Ensure smooth communication channels between employees, supervisors, and business leadership
d. People experience projects, Diversity initiatives.
e. People Engagement Initiatives
f. Me@SG Survey action points & executions accordingly.
HR Operations & Policy Compliance
a. Advise and ensure compliance of internal HR policies, and manufacturing safety standards across the float line workforce.
b. Partner with COEs (Compensation, Payroll, Learning & Development, Talent Acquisition) for effective rollout of HR programs.
c. Demonstrated ability to deploy functional knowledge.
d. Understanding of HR policies and processes.
Data, Analytics & Reporting
a. Use HR data (turnover, absenteeism, training effectiveness, performance ratings) to generate insights that drive decisions for operational improvements.
b. Prepare and share dashboards with Float Line leadership to monitor key people metrics and suggest interventions.
QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
MBA In HR or MSW with specialization in Human Resources.
Minimum 10 years’ experience.
Specific Skills required:
Good people connect & interpersonal skills
Assertiveness
Learning Agility & Multitasking
Personal credibility
Service Orientation
Execution Excellence
Team Player
Key Competencies for HRBP in a Manufacturing/Float Line Setting
Strong business acumen and understanding of float glass manufacturing operations and workforce challenges.
Excellent stakeholder management & influencing skills, especially with plant managers.
Analytical mindset to measure HR impact against operational outcomes.
Effective communication and coaching skills to guide supervisors and operators alike

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales Approach and Target Orientation: The desired RMH candidate must have an excellent aptitude for sales and marketing and must be very focused towards generating quality leads with maximum probability for conversion. He/she must have a strong orientation to generate and bring new customers to the branches and add new customers to our fold.
2. Exceptional Planning and Execution Skills: RMH must plan and execute the local flavored activities for the branches of the Region allocated to the RMH to ensure that the branches achieve their monthly and quarterly business targets of New Customer Acquisition for Gold Loan and Other Financial Products. New customer acquisition (new KYC) is the primary metric on which an RMHs effectiveness will be measured and hence RMHs primary focus must be to ensure his/her Region achieves its new KYC target without fail.
3. Monitoring Skills: RMHs must coordinate with the branches and the vendors on a regular basis to ensure the proper execution of the sanctioned regional BTL activities. He/she should have the ability to take branch staff along and ensure the BTL activities are conducted effectively and collectively to create top quality leads. He/she should also have the ability to foresee if there are any possible leakages or misreporting being done at agency level and should be able to check it, plug it and correct it.
4. Competition Tracking & Monitoring: RMH should proactively visit branches of competitors and prepare a counter competition strategy on a monthly / Quarterly basis to highlight what competitors are doing in his Region at BTL level and how does he/she plan to counter it.
5. Branch visits: All branches of in his/her Region must be visited by the RMH at least once in every Quarter to understand the on-ground issues, faade related branding issues, use/misuse of branch collaterals and merchandise, understand the branchs catchment area, competitors active in the respective branchs neighborhood and then finally plan and execute effective marketing initiatives which are specific to the branch, to address identified issues.
6. Branch Branding and Visual Branch Merchandise: RMH must ensuring effective branch branding, ensuring every branch in his Region stands out and is well-equipped with prominent and well-placed lit Glow Sign Boards (GSBs and Vertical GSBs), suitable quantity of branch merchandise, collaterals etc It is also his/ her responsibility to ensure that no branch has abundance of marketing collaterals / marketing material which lies unused or gets wasted later. Thus, his / her role does not end with just supplying this material but also includes their best utilization to drive business impact and ensure nil wastage.
7. Branch Launch: Whenever a new branch is being opened, RMH is entrusted with preparing a detailed report on the available opportunity in the branchs catchment area and once the branch opening date is finalized, he/she is expected to plan a detailed marketing plan with various new branch opening activities that create awareness in the neighborhood and also drives footfall and business conversion for the new branch.
8. Vendor Management: RMH is expected to bring with him/her a good network of vendors, marketing agencies, partners, and collaborators with whom he can work closely to execute his marketing plans. He/she should also have good negotiation skills to ensure he gets the best out of his partners without compromising quality of execution.
9. Lead Management: RMH must also ensure that branches follow-up on leads generated through BTL activities timely and effectively. He must ensure leads so generated are entered in CRM under correct marketing activity source and converted aggressively to achieve targets.
10. Coordination for ATL Activities: RMH must coordinate with Corporate Office and monitor the execution of the ATL Activities such as Newspaper Ad releases, Outdoor Campaigns, Cable TV activities, TV Ads in Regional Channels etc Effectively and bring to the notice of seniors at CO North Marketing department in case he/she observes any anomalies.
MIS: RMH must prepare a monthly MIS of the response generated by the local BTL Activities along with other monitoring of ATL/BTL Campaigns. Timely execution of BTL activities as per CRM schedule, sharing of periodic reports with 100% execution photographs is also an important part of his / her role.


Preferred candidate profile
1. Graduation / Post Graduation
2. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant work experience in marketing domain, preferably with BFSI / Retail exposure. Professionals with increased work experience will be treated differently.
3. Good communication skills, fairly good in written and spoken English
4. Excellent knowledge of MS Office
5. Extremely honest, committed and must possess highest degree of integrity.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Governance, controls, and culture of excellence
Business partnership, ownership and accountability
Team / People leadership

Use key qualitative and quantitative metrics to inform decision-making and HR strategies
Implement diversity initiatives to raise awareness and improve gender diversity and inclusion
Participate in senior leadership team meetings, consulting on HR topics including leadership, policies and practices, diversity and inclusion, and talent management
Provide people leadership by fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning and feedback, sharing best practices, and actively supporting the development of the HR team
Your skills and experience
MBA (HR) with a minimum of 10+ years of HR domain experience, including strong knowledge of HR policies, products and processes
At least 3 5 years of experience within the Banking sector
Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building and communication skills
Experience working in a complex, multicultural, matrix organisation
Ability to operate independently and objectively to achieve the right people outcomes for the franchise
Solutions-oriented with an innovative mindset
Strong HR background with demonstrable business acumen and commercial understanding
Comfortable presenting to senior management groups, with the ability to produce concise, data-backed presentations and conduct necessary research and inquiry

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their
respective base locations.
About the Team -
Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
Role Summary -
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned
Responsibilities -
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.



Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
"We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for
employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic
protected by the law."

Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Position: Associate/Senior Associate-IP and Corporate Law
Location: Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Mumbai
PQE: 3 to 5 Years
Education: LLB (3 years or 5 years)/ LLM


Job Profile-:
Filing Prosecution of IP Applications and providing legal opinion on IP matters.
Preparing, maintaining and updating client IP portfolio
Handle client queries on IP Practices in India and draft legal opinions.
Prepare Notice of Opposition as well as Counter Statement Reply, Notices and Rejoinders.
Attending show cause hearings at Trademark Registry.
Managing and Maintaining IP filings, prosecution and renewals.
Drafting and reviewing contracts and legal documents for clients and advising them on legal matters; sending legal notices.
Statutory Compliances arising under company law, ROC compliances, Labor Law, FSSAI, legal metrology, Ecommerce, Cyber laws, health sanitary law and drugs cosmetics laws, etc.
Advising clients, drafting opinions and common law research.


SKILLS REQUIRED
Should possess excellent analytical, drafting skills and have solution driven approach.
Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
Effective time management and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently without supervision.
Outstanding negotiation and communication skills, with sharp attention to detail.
Be an excellent team player with the ability to prioritize work.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment
AboutCompany:
S. S. Rana & Co. is a premier Indian IP and Corporate Law firm. With its head office offices in New Delhi and five other branch offices in India, it is one of the very few IP firms to be registered as an advocate on record with the Supreme Court, thus representing clients from the district courts right up to the Supreme Court, the countrys apex court.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience
