Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

Description:
Education/Certifications:
Bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in B.Tech, BBA, or MBA from a Tier 2/3 institution.
2- 4 years of relevant professional experience in a highly process-driven and regulated industry, preferably within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare sector.
Experience in financial reconciliation, regulatory compliance, and an understanding of U.S. or global healthcare payer and provider regulations is preferred.
Roles and Responsibilities:
The Associate will be responsible for collecting, reviewing, and validating internal and external Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organization (HCO) program documentation, including invoices, proof-of-service records, and contracts. The role involves reconciling financial transactions, assessing reportability in accordance with CMS guidelines, and ensuring accurate and timely transparency reporting in designated systems of record.
The Associate will also be responsible for identifying and resolving data discrepancies, escalating potential compliance risks or anomalies, and ensuring adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and applicable local, national, and international regulatory reporting deadlines.
Other responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
Collect, validate, and reconcile invoices for standalone HCP/HCO activities within designated systems of record.
Review, classify, and categorize invoice line items based on spend type, nature of expenditure, and HCP/HCO participation.
Prepare and maintain transparency reporting templates, ensuring accurate documentation of itemized spend and transfers of value (ToV).
Coordinate requests for recipient and client identification numbers for U.S. and Outside U.S. (OUS) HCPs/HCOs through designated outreach systems.
Develop and maintain compliance checklists for individual HCP/HCO engagements to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements.
Identify missing or incomplete vendor information and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to obtain the necessary documentation.
Collaborate with client stakeholders, compliance and business teams to facilitate seamless project execution and timely delivery.
Support process standardization, continuous improvement initiatives, and the maintenance of process playbooks and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as part of change management activities.
Monitor deliverables against agreed timelines, proactively identify potential risks or delays, and escalate issues to appropriate stakeholders.
Serve as a point of contact (POC) for routine reporting, status updates, and follow-up activities with client stakeholders.
Perform additional responsibilities aligned with the role and evolving business or project requirements.
Skills:
2-4 years of relevant experience, preferably in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare compliance, or regulatory reporting domain.
Intermediate to Advanced Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Familiarity with Smartsheet or similar workflow management tools is an advantage.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate HCP, HCO, and patient engagement activities in accordance with defined processes and compliance requirements.
Working knowledge of HCP/HCO transparency reporting, CMS Open Payments guidelines, and applicable regulatory compliance requirements is preferred.
Ability to consolidate, interpret, and analyze data from multiple sources while identifying discrepancies, anomalies, and potential compliance risks.
Strong financial acumen, including hands-on experience in invoice reconciliation, expense validation, and financial data analysis.
Excellent attention to detail, with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, completeness, and quality.
Strong English communication skills, including reading comprehension, business writing, documentation, and stakeholder correspondence.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high standards of quality and regulatory compliance.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and consistently meet SLAs and report deadlines.
Effective interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision and contribute positively to cross-functional teams.
Prior exposure to transparency reporting, compliance screening, or background verification processes within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry would be an added advantage.

Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an IFS Cloud EAM - Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver tailored solutions within our Business Application Consulting practice. You will focus on Maximo Consulting, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges and optimize operations. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections, anticipate needs, and navigate ambiguity to deliver quality work. You will guide and mentor others, using your skills to analyze complex concepts and develop a deeper understanding of the business context.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of the Business & Supply Chain Operations network, contributing to Field Service & Operations Modernisation initiatives. You will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, enhancing your personal brand and technical skills. This position offers the opportunity to grow professionally while working in a dynamic environment that values relationship building and personal growth.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement custom solutions in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP. Customize IFS modules to meet specific business needs by writing and modifying PL/SQL code, utilizing APIs, and creating custom fields, menus, and reports.
Develop and implement integration solutions using IFS Connect/REST (OData/Projections) and coordinate cutover to Ensure seamless data flow and integrity across the organization.
Own data migration using templates, cleansing rules, validation, migration jobs and coordinate cutover. 
Configure IFS Cloud Aurana (Lobbies, Workflows, pages, custom fields/actions, projections), permissions/security, and application parameters.
Develop reports/analytics using Quick Reports/SQL, IFS Report Designer, IFS Report Studio.
Collaborate with functional teams, business analysts, and project managers to gather requirements and create technical specifications. Document technical changes, configurations, and custom code to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability.
Provide technical support to resolve complex issues within the IFS system, identifying root causes and implementing timely fixes. Troubleshoot performance issues and recommend optimization techniques to enhance system efficiency.
Support the upgrade process for IFS Cloud, including testing, data migration, and user acceptance testing. Work closely with the IFS support team and internal IT to manage patches, upgrades, and enhancements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on root-cause analysis and solution-based development.
Effective communication skills to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage development tasks within project timelines and adapt to changing priorities.
High level of accuracy and focus on quality in development work and documentation.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Minimum 5+ years of experience working with IFS Cloud and 2+ years of experience in Integration Experience.
5+ years of experience as a technical developer in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP environments.
Experience in at least 2 end to end implementation of any IFS Cloud Projects
Implementation and configuration knowledge across IFS Cloud ERP, EAM,
Demonstrated configuration expertise in core EAM processes (PM programs, work orders, resources, failure codes, materials).
Working knowledge of Projections/REST APIs, IFS Connect, security/permission sets, and data migration tools.
Strong PLSQL (Oracle) for troubleshooting and Reports.

Experience: 7-20 years
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai

A talented, versatile, and hands-on **Functional Payments Expert** responsible for devising and delivering cutting-edge, innovative payment solutions. The ideal candidate is a **self-motivated individual** with strong awareness of payments industry trends, bank processing models, payment security, and end-to-end transaction lifecycles with understanding of Technology to design a solution.
Strong **business acumen**, positive work ethics, and a **collaborative mindset** are key to success in this role. The candidate will work closely with **cross-functional teams** including business, product, analytics, UX, and engineering, requiring excellent **articulation, negotiation, and influencing skills** due to high stakeholder visibility.
This role acts as a **bridge between business, product, and implementation teams**, translating business needs into scalable, high-performance payment solutions. The individual is expected to be an **effective leader, mentor, and thought leader**, contributing to future-ready payment architectures and strategies.
The role combines **functional design leadership, solution selling, and client-facing engagement**, requiring deep working knowledge of payments and modern distributed system architectures.
Your future duties and responsibilities
ead techno-functional design and solution definition for complex payment systems, translating business requirements into scalable and resilient solutions
Act as a bridge between business, product, and engineering teams, ensuring alignment across requirements, design, and implementation
Drive requirement elicitation, analysis, and documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, data/message mappings, and user stories
Own end-to-end functional design for payment flows, including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
Define and review functional decomposition aligned to microservices and domain-driven design principles
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure functional designs align with technical architecture (such as microservices, MQ or Kafka-based event flows, database modelling, UI design etc.).
Validate functional designs against non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, resiliency, security, and regulatory compliance
Support Development, FAT, UAT and implementation phases, including scenario definition, validation support, and issue analysis.
Provide functional guidance during production issue analysis and root cause investigations, especially for payment failures and reconciliation breaks.
Engage directly with clients and senior stakeholders, presenting designs, explaining solution options, and influencing design decisions
Contribute to solution selling and pre-sales activities, including proposal support, solution walkthroughs, and client discussions.
Mentor junior designers and analysts, promoting best practices and thought leadership in payments design.
Contribute to future-state architecture and product roadmap discussions, incorporating industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
Ensure all functional artifacts are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, supporting operational and compliance needs.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and cross-team design reviews.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must-Have Skills:
General / Functional Skills
* Proven experience in **product development** with strong focus on **techno-functional design, decomposition, and solution definition**
* Strong **UML modeling skills**, preferably using **Sparx Enterprise Architect**
* Ability to understand, analyze, and document **business requirements** from diverse stakeholders
* Expertise in **Business Analysis**, **Requirement Elicitation**, **Gap & Impact Analysis**, **Message/Data Mapping**, and **FAT validation**
* Experience producing **BRDs, Functional Specifications, Process Flow Diagrams, User Stories, Backlogs**, and related artifacts
* Excellent **written and verbal communication skills**
* Strong **client-facing experience**, including interaction with senior executives (internal and external)
* Solid understanding of **technical aspects of software products**, including:
* Interfaces & APIs
* Connectivity & integration patterns
* Databases
* Application servers & middleware
* SOA and distributed systems
* Data warehousing, archival, and purge strategies
* Hands-on experience across the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
* Strong working knowledge of **Agile delivery models**
Payments Domain Expertise
* Extensive experience in **payments-related software development projects or products**
* Strong proficiency in **SWIFT**, **SWIFT GPI**, **NACHA**, **CHAPS**
* Hands-on experience with **Clearing & Settlement Systems** across **Europe, Canada, and the US**
* Experience working with **at least two clearing systems in different countries**
* Proven track record of **product or project implementation** in **medium to large-scale banks**
Architecture & Technology (Key Additions)
* Strong **working knowledge of Microservices Architecture**, including:
* Service decomposition and domain-driven design concepts
* API-driven integration and service orchestration
* Working knowledge of designing interfaces.
* Resilience, scalability, and fault-tolerance considerations in payment systems
* Performance optimization and high availability considerations
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams to ensure **functional designs align with scalable, performant system architectures**
Good-to-Have Skills:

* Exposure to **product roadmap planning** and **DevOps strategies**
* Site implementation experience with leading payment products such as **Fundtech** or **Clear2Pay**
* Experience representing organizations in **external forums, industry panels, or conferences**
* Strong understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and operational readiness for payment platforms**

Integrate evaluation as a mandatory gate in CI/CD before production releases.

Build LLM observability: tracing, token usage, latency, error rates, and prompt/response logging (MLflow Tracing, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or OpenTelemetry).
Set up dashboards and alerts (Grafana, Prometheus, Databricks SQL dashboards) with defined SLAs/SLOs.
Drive root-cause analysis and automated retraining or rollback triggers.
5. Model & Prompt Governance (Unity Catalog)
Govern models, prompts, features, vector indexes, and datasets using Unity Catalog.
Implement prompt versioning, prompt registries, and model lineage tracking.
Enforce access control, audit logging, PII handling, and responsible AI guardrails.
Ensure compliance with internal security policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, EU AI Act where applicable).
6. Databricks Workflows & Airflow
Orchestrate ML and LLM pipelines using Databricks Workflows (Jobs) and Apache Airflow.
Design robust DAGs with dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLA monitoring.
Integrate orchestration with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
7. RAG Pipeline Operations
Operationalize Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and generation.
Manage vector databases (Databricks Vector Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.) including index sync, refresh, and scaling.
Monitor and improve retrieval quality (recall@k, MRR, context precision) and embedding freshness.
Optimize chunking strategies, hybrid search, re-ranking, and caching for performance and cos

Role: Devops and Cloud L3 & Architect
Exp: 7yrs to 18yrs
Location Flex: Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Shift: Rotational
Mode of Working: Hybrid

Mandatory Skill to Apply: Devops + Multi Cloud( Any 2- AWS/Azure/GCP) + CI/CD or Jenkins + Git + IAC (Terraform or Automation or Ansible)

Core / Must-Have Skills:-

Strong CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
Strong hands-on Terraform
Docker & Kubernetes
At least one managed Kubernetes platform: EKS / AKS / GKE
Helm and/or Argo CD
Python and/or Shell/Bash scripting
Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs

Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales
Education:
BE/B.Tech/MCA/BCA/BSC CS with 60%+

Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX™, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000,

Description:
Role / Job Title - Senior Associate
Experience 2 - 10 years

Key Skills Oracle EPM, FCCS

Project type - Support and Enhancement Project

Work Location
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune,Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

Expected to have good knowledge of Financial Close and Consolidation Cloud (FCCS) and or HFM(11.x), Regulatory reporting and Financial Close Process.
Good hands-on experience on Multi GAAP and Multi currency applications.
Need to have sound functional understanding of Income statement, Balance Sheet, different methods of consolidation and their calculations and disclosure in financial statements.
Sound experience to understand the Elimination process, consolidation Methods and Chart of Accounts.
Proficiency in understanding business requirements and translating them into HFM and or FCCS solutions.
Responsible for building prototypes, creating process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), leading testing and training activities, defining support procedures and SLAs and supporting implementations post go live.
Good understanding of EPMA & Classic application.
Understands the dependencies and interrelationships between various components of Hyperion Suite.
Provide alternatives and recommendations based on best practices and application functionality.
Understands P&L, balance sheet and cash flow development across multiple industries.
Well-versed in the FDMEE/Data Management integration process from different sources.
Knowledge on Supplemental data management and close manager
Monthly close process/consolidation; create and maintain end-user web forms; develop and maintain rules based on business needs.
Responsible for validation of data for movement between financial applications.
Good knowledge in creating Financial Reports/Narrative Reporting
Responsible for troubleshooting and resolving end-user issues submitted through ServiceNow application related to HFM and FCCS applications
Troubleshoot system business rules and data load procedures.
Maintain/create EPM automation scripts in Windows/Unix.
Should have the ability to lead the Project.
Ability to take up cross competency work and contribute to COE activities.
Understanding of Escalation/Risk management.
Should be good at preparing and delivering end user training and patch release documents..
Should have good knowledge in creating Profiles, Formats and reconciliations in ARCS
Should have strong knowledge in Transaction Matching and Reconciliations for ARCS
Good Knowledge in ARCS reports and sql scripting

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Your Role

Lead the design and delivery of water, wastewater, stormwater, and utility infrastructure projects, including pumping stations, reservoirs, detention tanks, manholes, outfalls, headworks, and storm overflow chambers.
Prepare, review, and approve civil and structural designs, calculations, specifications, reports, drawings, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).

Bachelor's degree in civil engineering is required, with a Master's degree in Environmental or Structural Engineering considered advantageous.
6+ years of professional experience in the design and delivery of water, wastewater, stormwater, and utility infrastructure projects, preferably including UK/European and Design Build projects.
Strong expertise in water and wastewater infrastructure, including pipelines, pumping stations, reservoirs, water-retaining structures, drainage systems, and utility networks.
Sound knowledge of pipework design, site development, drainage, earthworks, site grading, buried infrastructure, and utility coordination.
Experience in the structural design of reinforced concrete and steel structures, including liquid-retaining and wastewater treatment facilities.

Proficient in preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, design reports, reinforcement detailing, and BBS.
Experience with hydraulic modelling, GIS applications, BIM/3D coordination, clash detection, and engineering software such as Autodesk Robot or equivalent tools.
Strong multidisciplinary coordination and design management skills, with experience managing design changes, QA processes, constructability reviews, and construction support.

- Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team and foster positive relationships.
- Basic understanding of insurance products and the sales process is a plus.

Description:
We are seeking a Finance Controller / Financial Management Analyst to support financial planning, forecasting, P&L management, and business finance activities for a portfolio of client accounts. The role requires close collaboration with business leaders, delivery teams, and stakeholders to drive financial performance, profitability, revenue assurance, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage and control the organization's own business unit/division/cost center P&L, including revenue, cost, margin, forecasting, budgeting, and profitability analysis.
Support monthly forecasting activities including revenue, cost, and margin projections.
Perform month-end closing activities for revenue and cost accounting.
Conduct detailed Actual vs Forecast variance analysis and provide business insights.
Ensure accurate revenue recognition and accruals across projects.
Drive timely invoicing, monitor invoicing backlogs, and support cash collection activities.
Track Days Outstanding Receivable (DOR) and improve collection efficiency.
Identify opportunities to improve account profitability and drive margin improvement initiatives.
Prepare dashboards, financial reports, KPI analysis, and management presentations.
Monitor project financials, identify risks proactively, and recommend mitigation actions.
Collaborate with global stakeholders, account teams, and delivery leadership.

Qualification
MBA Finance / MMS Finance / M.Com / CMA / CA or equivalent finance qualification.
6-12 years of experience in FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Financial Analysis, P&L Controlling, or Financial Controllership.
Experience in IT Services, Consulting, Technology, or Shared Services environment preferred.

Variance Analysis

Advanced Excel

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Description:
The Team: Morningstar DBRS – Credit Operations Mumbai Analytics
 The Group: Morningstar DBRS (MDBRS) is a global credit ratings business with about 800 employees in eight offices globally. Formed through the acquisition of DBRS by Morningstar, Inc., the credit ratings business is the fourth-largest provider of credit ratings in the world. Morningstar DBRS is committed to empowering investor success, serving the market through leading-edge technology, and raising the bar for the industry. Morningstar DBRS is a market leader in Canada, the U.S. and Europe in multiple asset classes. Morningstar DBRS rates more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities worldwide, and is driven to bring more clarity, diversity, and responsiveness to the ratings process. Visit: https://dbrs.morningstar.com/about to learn more.
 Credit Operations Mumbai Analytics team enables and supports the efficient and effective delivery of credit ratings/information to the market with its specialized skills and assets, consistent frameworks, and economies of scale. We collaborate with MDBRS global stakeholders to build creative, impactful solutions and offer services for the business and the market.
 The Role: Morningstar DBRS’s Corporate team is looking for a motivated individual with good analytical skills and a desire to learn. This role will provide unique opportunities for learning key aspects of the credit ratings process including in-depth fundamental analysis of high-yield Corporate borrowers across multiple industries in support of analysts based in North America & Europe. You will be responsible for providing data, research and financial modeling support utilized to produce company and sector specific credit reports that incorporate creative insights and support activities across the ratings value chain. This position is based in our Navi Mumbai office.
 Key Responsibilities:
Develop an understanding of and build proficiency in credit analysis
Provide support to global analytical teams in monitoring news, announcements, or other material events impacting corporate credits
Assist in preparing financial models, including, but not limited to, updating financial information, reconciling data, maintain company and peer group historical financial results and credit metrics, etc.
Maintain industry data through ongoing research/ review of company filings, presentations, and industry publications
Provide research support and help collect, organize, and analyze data from internal and external sources for use in company-specific and industry commentaries and reports authored by the global analytical team
Review and summarize credit & legal documentation, etc.
Assist the global analytical teams or senior analysts in preparing credit rating memos, rationales, etc. or parts thereof
Track, review and maintain documentation and various operational databases to help support the credit rating process
Ensure compliance with regulatory and company policies and procedures
 Requirements:
Master’s or Postgraduate in Management (Finance) or CA or CFA Level 3 or any such equivalent qualification
Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in capital markets, corporate credit analysis, analyzing credit risk of high yield or leveraged loan issuers, etc. or experience in auditing corporate financial statements at a nationally recognized accounting firm with CPA license
Good understanding of core finance and accounting concepts
Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and/ or IFRS accounting rules is strongly desired
Robust quantitative and analytical skills supported by strong attention to detail and accuracy
Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills
Highly motivated, self-starter who is keen to learn, has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic
Ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and deliver results in a timely manner
Good inter-personal skills and ability to participate/ contribute as a team player
 Morningstar DBRS is an equal opportunity employer.
 Hybrid model – partial work from home option where employee will from Morningstar’s Navi Mumbai offices 4 days a week (subject to change as per organizational directive).
AboutCompany: Morningstar, Inc. is a leading provider of independent investment insights in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The Company offers an extensive line of products and solutions that serve a wide range of market participants, including individual and institutional investors in public and private capital markets, financial advisors and wealth managers, asset managers, retirement plan providers and sponsors, and issuers of fixed-income securities. Morningstar provides data and research insights on a wide range of investment offerings, including managed investment products, publicly listed companies, private capital markets, debt securities, and real-time global market data. Morningstar also offers investment management services through its investment advisory subsidiaries, with approximately $328 billion in AUMA as of Sept. 30, 2024. The Company operates through wholly-owned subsidiaries in 32 countries.

Job Description
Overview
We are seeking talented individuals for our Water Team to work on diverse sewerage projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment.

Your role
Work as part of AtkinsRealis' Urban Drainage Modelling team.
Work on a range of projects relating to sewerage/storm network modelling, drainage infrastructure design and planning from Bangalore/Gurgaon offices.
Work to high standards, ensuring right first-time delivery.
Ownership of the work of self and juniors they work with.
Support the technical development of Graduates and Technicians and contribute positively through knowledge sharing.

About you

Bachelor or Master's Degree in Civil Engineering or MSc in Geology from a recognised University.
2 - 4 years of experience in the water and wastewater consultancy industry

Experience of using design or hydraulic modelling software (preferably in InfoWorks CS/2D/ICM or Windes or Bentley suite of software).
Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems (GIS) e.g. MapInfo, ArcGIS.
Excellent report writing skills and fluency in English.

Value addition through innovations and automation in project delivery.

Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Role : Counterparty Onboarding Relationship Manager - Supply Chain Finance

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.

Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.

Job Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.

Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.

Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.

About Global Network:

Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.

Why Technology Consulting

The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.

As technology rapidly evolves, it's more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client's toughest business problems.

Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients :Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses :Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connectedlandscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:

Working closely with our clients, Consulting professionals design, build and implement ServiceNow and ITSM transformation strategies that enhance service delivery, operational resilience, and enterprise performance. They develop specialized expertise - process, platform, industry, and architectural in a dynamic project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.

The opportunities to make a difference within large-scale service transformation initiatives are limitless in today's digital enterprise landscape. Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities:
Lead large-scale ServiceNow and ITSM transformation programs across multiple business units
ITSM processes Transformation/Modernization using Agentic AI/Gen AI
Design enterprise ITSM strategy and ServiceNow roadmap aligned to business and digital objectives
Conduct current-state assessments and define future-state service management operating models
Architect scalable ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC modules or any other ServiceNow modules
Drive CMDB strategy, service mapping, automation, and platform governance frameworks
Translate complex business requirements into functional designs and implementation blueprints
Implement programs/interventions that prepare the organization for new service management processes
Identify, assess, and solve complex IT service management challenges requiring structured evaluation
Oversee end-to-end implementation including configuration, integrations, data migration, and hypercare
Provide thought leadership in ITSM best practices, ITIL alignment, and platform optimization
Drive enterprise service architecture, integration architecture, and process standardization
Help clients transition from fragmented service processes to an integrated, automation-first platform
Manage multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate, and deliver ServiceNow engagements
Participate in client proposals, presentations, and solution defense discussions
Effectively communicate target-state service architecture and transformation journey to executive stakeholders
Cloud Architecture with private, public and hybrid cloud architectures, pros/cons, and Hybrid cloud integration architecture for clients



Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
MBA from a Tier-1 institute (preferred)
12+ years of consulting experience and/or working with large enterprises leading ServiceNow and ITSM transformation programs
Strong experience in ITSM strategy, process assessment, service operating model design, and enterprise platform implementation
Proven experience across ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC/IRM
ServiceNow certifications such as CIS (ITSM/ITOM/SPM/HRSD/GRC) preferred
ITIL certification (v3/v4) strongly preferred
Cloud Architecture certification (Azure or GCP or AWS)


Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale ServiceNow and ITSM transformation engagements across enterprise environments. The ideal candidates will have deep expertise in ITSM strategy, service operating model design, platform architecture, and multi-module ServiceNow implementations (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, GRC), with hands-on experience across the full lifecyclefrom assessment and solution design to implementation and optimizationfocused on driving measurable service excellence and digital transformation outcomes
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.


Key Competencies and Skills:

The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes

ITSM Enterprise Service Transformation Experience leading enterprise-wide ITSM transformations, designing target service operating models, process standardization, and automation-first service architectures aligned to ITIL best practices. Exposure to Agentic AI/Gen AI for Processes modernization

ServiceNow Platform Architecture Experience designing scalable ServiceNow architecture across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC/IRM modules, including CMDB strategy, service mapping, governance models, and platform upgrade strategy.

ServiceNow Solution Design Integration Expertise in translating business requirements into functional and technical designs, including integrations (API, IntegrationHub, MID Server), data models, workflow orchestration, and enterprise toolchain integration.

CMDB ITOM Strategy Delivering CMDB maturity roadmaps, discovery strategy, data governance frameworks, and event management integration to enable operational visibility and reliability.

Implementation Program Leadership Driving large-scale ServiceNow implementations from roadmap definition to deployment and hypercare, managing cross-functional teams and multi-region rollouts.

Service Automation Digital Workflow Enablement Designing automated service experiences leveraging Flow Designer, catalog orchestration, AI/Virtual Agent capabilities, and performance analytics.

Secondary Skills (Preferred)
Application Modernization Experience leading and designing the composable architecture leveraging Microservices, EDA on the Cloud Platforms.
Cloud Architecture:Experience with private, public and hybrid cloud architectures, pros/cons, and Hybrid cloud integration architecture
Cloud-native application development, DevOps and data integration within cloud platform
Cloud Migration:Delivering cloud migration roadmaps and managing execution from a project management perspective.
Cloud Deployment across various hyper-scaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and models (PaaS, SaaS, IaaS), containers and virtualization platforms (VMWare.)
AIOps Intelligent Operations Exposure to AIOps concepts including event correlation, noise reduction, predictive analytics, and automation-driven incident management within IT operations environments.
IT Infrastructure Architecture Working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure components including networks, servers, virtualization, containers, middleware, and security layers to ensure accurate CMDB modeling and service dependency mapping.

Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POV's
