Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

3 5 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.

Deep understanding of data supply chain and building value realisation frameworks for data transformations.

Key Responsibilities
Continuous deployment and delivery using Azure DevOps
Implement the security policy so that the system is secure at operating system, database and application server level (this includes also regular patching of the entire environment

Perform High Availability and Disaster Recovery tests with support from other IT teams

IT Operations/Support experience combined with analytical skills to identify root causes in workflows incidents (data, technical, functional).

Experience or affinity with IT Risk (SOx, vulnerability management) and Security concepts (protocols, certificates, etc.)

Experience with managing full-stack vendor packages, and additionally (low latency) infrastructural stack knowledge

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:

Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking a CANDU Quality Specialist to support the delivery of world-class nuclear projects across the global CANDU portfolio.
Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.
Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies.
Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities.
Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams.
Engineering Quality
Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes.
Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.
Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records.
Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns.
Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments.
Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections.
Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure.
Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities.
Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders.
Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
About You
The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures.
They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements.
The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery.
Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects.

Degree in Engineering and Quality Management

Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities.
Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Working knowledge of
CSA N299 Series

Nuclear Safety Culture principles

Design Control and Verification

Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations relevant reports.
Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.
Core Skills:
Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
LEED Accredited Professional
6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results
Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases
Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, AutoCAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Desirable but not essential
Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, SketchUp, and Rhino

Varied, interesting, and meaningful work.
A hybrid working environment with flexibility and opportunities for growth.
Access to training, with career progression or lateral moves as the team expands.
The chance to work with a large, global, multidisciplinary consultancy on a mission to transform business practices.

Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team supporting Middle East projects based out of India
The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.
The role is based in India and support projects in Dubai and across the UAE, KSA and the wider Middle East.
Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
Urban and Spatial Economics
Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.
Real Estate Economics
Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.
Development and Infrastructure Planning
Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.
Project Delivery
Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.
Business and Practice Development
Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRalis business.
Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.

Qualifications Skills
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
Master's degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.
Professional Experience / Qualifications
Typically +8 years of relevant experience;
Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous.
Behavioral Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

AtkinsRalis is one of the world's most respected design, engineering and project management consultancies, with a proven track record of more than 75 years of relevant experience in the industry. Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles and their application in Water, Wastewater Treatment plant and pumping stations.
Experience in the production of design documentations including optioneering reports, data sheets, calculations, and specifications of electrical equipment.
Undertake Electrical design to local and international standards, preferably for UK region.
Understand and apply BS/NEC/NFPA/IEC/International standards.

A competent user of IT tools in particular Word, Excel, Outlook and Electrical design tools e.g., AMTECH, ETAP, SKM. Dialux Evo, AGI32, Specsizer etc
Liaison with clients (Lead Project Offices), developing and maintaining relationships.
Responsible for completion of projects within his/her team to time, cost and quality.

Check/review electrical drawings and designs deliverables.
Coordinate with other disciplines and improve inter-discipline working with other disciplines such as Mechanical, Architecture, Civil and Structural.
Should have knowledge of 3D Models for check review of Navis works.
Demonstrate ability to cultivate and lead a cohesive team, fostering individual growth and collaboration withing the organization framework.

Master/Bachelor's Degree in Electrical engineering;
Previous electrical engineering or design role experience within consultancy.
Relevant and appropriate experience of more than 14+ years in Water Wastewater Treatment plant and Pumping stations.
Experience of working in Multi-D environment and good understanding of co-ordination and interfaces with other disciplines.
Able to independently deliver work and integrate with larger project teams.
Good report writing skills, experience of making presentations to and attending meetings with clients is essential.
Positive and enthusiastic, a confident communicator at all levels, and a collaborator.
Resilient, can work under pressure, doesn't show frustration, and lose composure when facing resistance.

Relevant and appropriate experience within Water, wastewater treatment plant and pumping station.
Competent designer UK, International codes and standards.
Knowledge of tools such as AMTECH, DIALUX EVO etc.
Review model using Navis tool.
Should have working knowledge of common data environment (CDE) like BIM360, ProjectWise etc.
Manage quality of deliverables of yours as well as the team members.
Maintains harmony and a productive atmosphere by being open about the work activities and project status.
An effective communicator both written and verbal.
People manager and should be able to develop electrical engineers.

Job Title -

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist

Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR

Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.

Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Job Description
Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You ll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
  Your Role
Working within our Nuclear business sector in our Bangalore or Gurgaon office, you will lead the delivery of AtkinsRealis technical design and engineering projects or work directly for our key clients.
You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
  About You
You ll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You ll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You ll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. You must also be able to successfully manage the commercial and quality performance of projects and proactively deploy a range of techniques to control delivery, cost, manage risk and change.
Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience
Direct and demonstrable experience of successfully managing one or more of the following types of projects to agreed time, cost and quality requirements:
Consultancy services supplying engineering advice, or
Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.
  Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsR alis
Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Engage confidently with CIO, CTO, CDAO, and business leadership on target state architecture, AI governance, operating model decisions, transformation sequencing, and value realization.

Demonstrated consulting experience working with CIO, CTO, CDAO, and senior business stakeholders to shape transformation agendas, define target states, build executive-ready recommendations, and drive alignment on operating model, governance, and technology decisions. Working exposure to one or more data management domains such as Data Governance, Master Data (MDM), Data Quality, Metadata Management, or Data Catalog is desirable, as a good-to-have capability supporting broader AI and data transformation programs. Experience in one or more technologies in the data governance space: Collibra, Alation, Talend, Informatica, SAP MDG, Stibo, Alteryx, or equivalent. Experience in at least two MDM technologies Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDG, or equivalent. Deep understanding of data supply chain and building value realisation frameworks for data transformations. 5+ years of experience leading or managing teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing Data & Analytics strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs. Knowledge of enterprise data architecture concepts through practical experience Digital Core, Data Mesh, API-first, AI Centre of Excellence design. Foundational understanding of data privacy (GDPR, DPDP, CCPA) and Responsible AI is desired. Strong understanding in any of the following industries preferred: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, Transportation, Automotive/Industrial, or equivalent. CDMP Certification from DAMA preferred. Cloud Data & AI Practitioner Certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) desirable but not essential.

Strong organizational, multitasking, time-management, and problem-solving abilities.

Focus on cost control, service quality, resource optimization, and operational excellence.
Educational Qualification: Any Graduate.

5-15 years of relevant experience in administration, facilities management, infrastructure management, real estate, or corporate office operations.

Payout shall be released within 72 banking hours after the receipt of 100 percent payment from the client.

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description Azure Data Engineer
Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving Fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specializing in Consumer Engagement Services in Technology, Telecom, Banking, Retail Operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. With more than 18,000 employees across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by people-first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the worlds leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Job Description
Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
4-6 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Position: Azure Lead
Location: Hyderabad, Indore
Duration: Full time


Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Position Summary:
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA or master’s degree is preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
9-14 years of professional work experience with at least 6 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory & Azure Databricks.
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Description:
Are you ready to write your next chapter
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We re looking for a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer to join our ever evolving Biller Solution team .
What you ll own as the Senior .NET Full Stack Developer
We are seeking an experienced .NET Full Stack and SOAP/REST APIs Developer to join our team. The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of software development principles and experience in developing and maintaining complex applications using ASP. Net Core. The candidate must also have experience using Git and other collaborative software development tools. Experience with SQL Server will be considered a plus. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions that meet our client needs. He will be part of Agile (Scrum) team, participating in Agile ceremonies. Core Business hours 1 PM 10 PM
What you bring:
7+ Yrs of Experience in Develop and maintain software applications using .NET Technologies (C#, ASP.NET Core, MVC, Web API).
Design and implement responsive and user-friendly front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks (Angular, jQuery, etc.)
Build, configure, and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for CI/CD, including automated build and deployment processes.
Manage and support Azure App Services, Virtual Machines, and related cloud infrastructure.
Configure, administer, and troubleshoot IIS servers for application hosting and performance optimization.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, design, and implement software features.
Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality standards are met.
Work with stakeholders to gather and refine software requirements.
Create and maintain technical documentation for software applications.
Ensure software applications are delivered on time and within budget.
Where youll own it
You will own it in our Vibrant Office Locations as Bangalore/Pune/Indore hub .
About the team
Public Sector (Biller Solution) is an end-to-end Electronic Presentment and Payment solution which enables billers to generate bills and accept payments for those bills from their customer base. Designed to address mid to large market gaps in product functionality. The engagement is mostly on new development, enhancement, bug fixes.

Summary:We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps/SRE Engineer with advanced experience in AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and reliability engineering. The role involves leading large-scale cloud initiatives, designing resilient architectures, improving system performance, and driving DevOps/SRE best practices across teams. Roles Responsibilities:1 Cloud Architecture AWS Expertise Design, implement, and optimize scalable, high-availability, and secure infrastructure on AWS. Architect network topologies including VPCs, subnets, route tables, NAT/IGW, Transit Gateway. Lead deployments for AWS services:EC2, ASG, ALB/NLB, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, EKS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudFront. Implement enterprise-grade security practices:IAM fine-grained policies, KMS encryption, WAF, GuardDuty, SCP policies. Drive cost optimization strategies:rightsizing, RI/Savings Plans, storage optimization. 2 Infrastructure as Code Automation Define IaC standards and build reusable modules using Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK. Automate provisioning of compute, networking, databases, and cluster components. Build advanced automation for deployments, scaling, patching, and configuration workflows. Mentor team members on IaC structures, environment segregation, and GitOps workflows. 3 CI/CD Release Engineering Architect and maintain complex CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline. Implement progressive delivery (blue/green, canary deployments) on Kubernetes or ECS/EKS. Introduce automated testing, security scanning, and deployment quality gates. Optimize release cycles and improve deployment frequency and stability. 4 Kubernetes Container Platforms Lead design and operations of EKS, ECS, or hybrid Kubernetes environments. Define cluster standards:node pools, networking, storage classes, ingress, autoscaling (HPA/Cluster Autoscaler). Manage Helm charts, GitOps operators (ArgoCD / Flux), and multi-cluster workloads. Enforce security controls (RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, secrets management). 5 Observability Reliability Engineering Build organization-wide observability using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK, OpenTelemetry. Implement distributed tracing, SLO/SLA monitoring, performance baselines, and anomaly detection. Lead major incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and reliability improvements. Build automated alerting strategies to reduce noise and improve MTTR. 6 Security, Compliance Governance Implement DevSecOps practices including vulnerability scanning, secret rotation, and policy enforcement. Use AWS security tools (Config, Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty) for governance. Establish environment separation, audit compliance, and SOC2/ISO-ready controls. 7 Leadership Collaboration Lead technical discussions, system architecture reviews, and cross-team DevOps adoption. Mentor junior and mid-level DevOps/SREs and build documentation/playbooks. Work closely with developers, architects, and product teams to improve reliability and performance. Professional
Technical Experience 6+ years DevOps/SRE experience in production-grade environments. Expert-level AWS skills:compute, networking, databases, storage, scaling, managed services. Strong hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS preferred). Expertise in Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. Strong CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions/Jenkins/Azure DevOps). Deep understanding of Linux, shell scripting, Python/Bash, debugging, and system internals. Strong knowledge of networking (DNS, load balancers, firewalls, VPC networking). Experience with monitoring/logging tools:Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK. Hands-on experience with distributed systems, microservices, and performance tuning. Nice to Have AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer Professional). Experience with Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd). Exposure to zero-downtime upgrades and multi-region active-active architectures. Knowledge of SSO, OAuth2, Cognito, Okta. Additional informationBachelor degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
Qualification15 years full time education

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. 13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role

2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset
