We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct

Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.

Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.

Key Aspects of the Role & Training:
Job Responsibilities: Appraisers test gold to determine its authenticity and market value , which directly informs the loan-to-value (LTV) ratio (often around 75%-90%). They are critical in preventing fraud and ensuring proper documentation.

Overview 
We are looking for driven and ambitious professionals to join our Global Business Development team and expand Faveo Helpdesk & Service Desk solutions across international markets. The role involves identifying and engaging global prospects, understanding customer requirements, conducting product demonstrations, managing the end-to-end sales cycle, and building long-term client relationships. Candidates with strong communication skills, a target-driven mindset, and an interest or experience in SaaS, technology, or international sales are encouraged to apply.
Location
Bangalore / Coorg (with flexibility for global shift timings)
About the Role
We are looking for driven and ambitious professionals to join our global sales team and help expand the reach of Faveo Helpdesk & Service Desk solutions across international markets.
In this role, you will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging with prospects, delivering product demonstrations, and closing deals with customers worldwide. You will play a key role in driving revenue growth while building strong, long-term relationships with global clients.
Comprehensive training on product and sales processes will be provided to help you succeed.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and engage prospective customers through calls, emails, and online channels
Present and demonstrate Faveo Helpdesk & Service Desk solutions to global clients
Understand customer requirements and propose suitable solutions
Manage the complete sales cyclefrom prospecting to closing deals
Prepare proposals, pricing, and commercial discussions
Consistently follow up and move prospects through the sales pipeline
Maintain accurate records of sales activities in CRM
Generate leads through outbound efforts (cold calls, cold emails, networking)
Build and maintain long-term customer relationships

Freshers (0–1 year)
Graduate in Business, Marketing, IT, or related fields
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Interest in SaaS / technology sales
Willingness to learn and work in a global sales environment
Experienced Candidates ( 5+ years)
Experience in sales, business development, or SaaS/product sales
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
Experience with international customers is a plus
Ability to manage end-to-end sales cycle independently
Skills Required
Excellent spoken and written English
Strong communication and persuasion skills
Confidence in delivering product demos
Ability to build relationships with global clients
Self-motivated, target-driven mindset
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts (global time zones)
What Success Looks Like
Consistently achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets
Converting qualified leads into paying customers
Building a strong pipeline of global prospects
Delivering high-quality product demonstrations
Contributing to overall revenue growth
What We Offer
Opportunity to work with global customers
Structured training on product and sales process
Exposure to international SaaS sales
High-growth career path in technology sales

FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.

This role requires strategic oversight and hands-on management to drive revenue growth across Essco s product lines, including faucets, sanitaryware, cisterns, and H.W.S. The Team Leader will take personal ownership of key Regional Distributors (RDs), ensure effective training of the sales team, and achieve substantial dealer growth. This role is pivotal in executing market strategies, enhancing dealer performance, and leading a high-performing team to meet and exceed targets.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Team Performance: Oversee and drive the performance of the Essco sales team to meet or exceed revenue targets across all product lines: ESSCO Faucets, ESSCO Sanitaryware, ESSCO Cisterns, and ESSCO H.W.S.
Key Account Management: Take personal ownership of select top RDs, ensuring they meet their sales targets and contribute to overall revenue performance
RSD Management: Manage and coordinate with Regional Sub-Distributors (RSDs) to ensure alignment with sales strategies and optimal performance
RD Recruitment & Selection: Identify and recruit suitable Regional Distributors (RDs) in consultation with the HOD/ZH
Dealer Growth: Drive dealer growth, ensuring a minimum of 85% of the dealer universe shows measurable expansion and increased productivity
Sales Team Training: Conduct and oversee targeted training sessions for the RD/RDS sales team to enhance their skills and performance, ensuring all training goals are met
Market Development: Develop and implement strategies to expand Essco s market presence, including penetrating new markets and increasing the brand s footprint in existing areas
Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed
Dealer Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers to foster growth, resolve issues, and enhance dealer satisfaction
Reporting: Provide regular reports to senior management on sales performance, market trends, and team progress, including insights and recommendations for strategic adjustments
Operational Efficiency: Ensure efficient and effective execution of sales operations, including compliance with company policies, pricing strategies, and promotional activities
Brand Visibility and Hygiene: Maintain high standards of brand visibility and hygiene across all dealer showrooms and points of sale
Issue Resolution and Coordination: Address and resolve any issues related to supplies, sales policies, and customer care in coordination with the relevant departments
Market Analysis: Conduct market surveys and analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Inventory Management: Ensure effective inventory management and supply chain operations to meet market demands
Promotional Activities: Lead the implementation of promotional activities and marketing campaigns to boost brand visibility and sales
Dealer and Customer Pipeline: Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of potential new dealers and customers
Compliance and Ethics: Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical standards in all business operations
OC & Factory Visits: Plan and facilitate visits to Orientation Centers (OCs) and the factory for potential external customers
Supply & Sales Issue Resolution: Address and resolve issues related to supplies, sales, and customer care for dealers and specifiers
Key Attributes
Proven ability to lead and motivate a sales team to achieve and exceed targets
Strong understanding of the building materials industry
Demonstrated success in managing key accounts and driving dealer growth
Effective training and development skills with a focus on enhancing team performance
Strategic thinking with the ability to implement tactical plans for market expansion and revenue growth
Strong analytical skills for monitoring performance and identifying improvement opportunities
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
An MBA or equivalent is preferred
Experience:
10-12 years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
3-4 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving team performance
Skills:
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Proficiency in strategic planning and execution
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive decision-making
Effective training and mentoring skills
Proactive problem-solving attitude and adaptability
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.

Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Essential:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.

About the Function: Sales is where our brands meet the real world. This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.

5. Mentoring
Mentoring a third-party team by reviewing Daily Reports towards achieving the business objectives
6. Collection
Monitor collection across CSD and Para Military

Qualification: MBA in Sales Marketing
Experience: 6 - 8 years experience in sales/ Worked in the Alco Bev or FMCG Industry
Knowledge skills
Business Growth Sales Management
Stakeholder Institutional Relationship Management
Business Development Infrastructure Enhancement
Best suited for someone who
A commercially driven sales professional with strong institutional relationship management capabilities, operational expertise, and a demonstrated ability to deliver sustainable business growth

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. 3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.

Civil construction and building works.

Structural and allied construction activities.

To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.

Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.

The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Description:
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow
Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
Serious about building a career in civil engineering and construction
Ready to learn both office-based technical work and site execution work
Punctual, honest, and responsible
Able to follow instructions and maintain professional discipline
Interested in residential, commercial, interior, and turnkey building projects
Comfortable working in a structured office environment
Experience
Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0 to 1 year of experience will be preferred.
Interview Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects Jorhat Head Office

Description:
APM Terminals
The Warehouse Manager is responsible for overseeing daily operations of a warehouse handling direct-to-consumer distribution. This role ensures seamless order fulfillment, inventory accuracy, and efficient warehouse operations while meeting customer satisfaction goals and adhering to safety and compliance standards. The role also ensures timely sorting, grading, transformation, and distribution of products to dark stores while maintaining quality, cold chain integrity, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities Operations Management
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
Inventory Control
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
Team Leadership
Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.
Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
Technology Utilization
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
Customer Experience Vendor Management
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.
Safety Compliance
Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.
Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.
Reporting KPIs
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.
Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.
Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Required Experience Skills
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.
Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.
Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the ficial performance in areas of responsibility.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. Other Admin/ operations related works

Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.
Candidates should mandatorily have a Light Motor(LMV), minimum 3 years old driving license.
Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language
Candidate should have good working knowledge of MS Office
Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.

Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.

Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Head - IT Infrastructure & Security Manager
You will be responsible for leading and managing the organization's IT infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity operations, and overall information security posture and ensuring high availability of critical systems and engaging directly with clients and external technology stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
1. IT Infrastructure Management
F Lead and resolve complex L3-level technical issues across networks, servers, storage, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
F Manage, monitor, optimize, and maintain IT infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and reliability.
F Administer and oversee:
Active Directory and Identity Management
DNS and DHCP
VPN and remote access solutions
Firewalls and network security
Endpoint and device management
Servers, storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments
F Manage cloud and SaaS environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Workspace.
F Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, automation, and performance-management solutions.
F Collaborate with global teams on capacity planning, infrastructure upgrades, modernization, and automation initiatives.
F Ensure business-critical systems meet defined uptime, performance, backup, and disaster recovery requirements.

2. Cybersecurity & Compliance
F Develop, implement, and enforce IT security policies, standards, procedures, and best practices.
F Strengthen and continuously improve the organization's overall cybersecurity posture.
F Manage and oversee security technologies, including:
Firewalls
IDS/IPS
Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
Antivirus and endpoint protection
Email security
Vulnerability management tools
Identity and access management solutions
F Lead security incident response activities, including investigation, containment, remediation, and post-incident reviews.
F Conduct and coordinate regular:
Security audits
Risk assessments
Vulnerability assessments
Penetration testing
F Drive vulnerability remediation and risk mitigation programs.
F Ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulatory requirements, including:
ISO 27001
SOC 2
GDPR
Other applicable industry and client security requirements
F Support internal and external security audits and maintain required documentation and evidence.
F Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness and security best-practice programs for employees.

3. Client Interaction & Technical Support
F Engage directly with clients on IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, and technical governance matters.
F Provide expert-level L3 technical support for complex client infrastructure and security issues.
F Participate in client onboarding and offboarding activities.
F Conduct technical reviews, infrastructure assessments, and security reviews.
F Support client audits, compliance assessments, and security questionnaires.
F Participate in regular service review and continuous service improvement meetings.
F Communicate technical risks and recommendations effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.

4. Leadership & Team Management
F Lead, mentor, and manage the IT & Security Support team, including L1 and L2 engineers.
F Provide technical guidance and escalation support for complex infrastructure and security issues.
F Define operational processes, escalation procedures, and technical standards.
F Drive skill development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.
F Collaborate with Operations, HR, Leadership, and other business functions to enable technology initiatives.
F Manage relationships with external technology vendors, service providers, and security partners.
F Evaluate and recommend new technologies, platforms, and tools to improve infrastructure efficiency, reliability, and security.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field with 12-15+ Years of experience working in a managed services, multi-client, or global IT environment & with Industry certifications such as:
CISSP
CISM
CCSP
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
Relevant cloud certifications from AWS or Microsoft Azure
2. Strong hands-on experience in enterprise IT Infrastructure and L3 Support.
3. Strong knowledge of networking technologies, including routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, and DHCP.
4. Experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, and identity management environments.
5. Experience with cloud infrastructure and services, particularly:
Microsoft Azure
AWS
Google Workspace
6. Strong understanding of endpoint management, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
7. Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and monitoring tools.

Cybersecurity & Compliance
1. Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and security best practices.
2. Practical experience with ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 frameworks and audit processes.
3. Knowledge of GDPR and other relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.
4. Experience managing security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR, endpoint protection, and email security.
5. Strong experience in:
Risk assessment
Vulnerability management
Incident response
Security audits
Penetration testing coordination
Security awareness programs

Leadership & Communication
1. Proven experience managing and mentoring technical support or infrastructure teams.
2. Strong client-facing and stakeholder-management skills.
3. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
4. Ability to explain complex technical and security issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
5. Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage critical incidents.

An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.

This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.

Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.

International experience.

Job Description- Territory Sales and Clinical Lead

About us

SigTuple builds intelligent screening solutions to aid diagnosis through AI-powered analysis of visual medical data from human and animal samples. Its flagship AI100 product is an in vitro diagnostic device that automates manual microscopy using robotics and AI, enabling biological samples on glass slides to be digitized for AI-aided remote reporting and analysis. Along the same lines, SigTuple is building a Point-of-Care (POC) screening device for veterinary use, expanding its technology and diagnostic solutions into the animal health space

As a Territory Sales and Clinical Lead,you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening SigTuplespresence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, and distributors. Your role will focus on building a strong customer base, key opinion leader relationships, executing sales cycle from lead generation till closure and post sales support.,

Responsibilities:
Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote SigTuple products and generate profitable sales.
Maintain a healthy pipeline and conduct demonstrations to close the sales as per targets assigned.
Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.
Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
Qualification & Experience:
0-2 years
Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science/ Science /Nursing/Biomedical /Diagnostics Medical Technician
Master's in related fields will be a plus.
Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge:
Strong understanding of the animal health market,
Experience working with clinics, hospitals & distributors.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.
Location:
Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Bangalore. Based in the city / should be a local permanent resident having full exposure to the territory field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.

Administration Manager (Corporate)
Oversees daily office operations, facility management, vendor contracts, budgets, and administrative staff to ensure seamless business continuity.
Core Responsibilities
Office & Facility Management:
F Oversee corporate workspace allocation, building maintenance, housekeeping, utilities, security systems, and meeting room infrastructure.
F Maintain a high-end, agile office environment, optimizing hot-desking/hoteling arrangements, collaborative breakout areas, and state-of-the-art virtual meeting spaces.
Vendor & Procurement Management:
F Negotiate vendor contracts (security, travel, catering, maintenance, high-end office suppliers, facilities engineering), while tracking operational spend against strict corporate budgets. Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and manage office supply inventory.
Budget & Cost Control:
F Prepare and manage departmental operating budgets, track expenses, and identify cost-saving efficiencies.
Travel & Event Logistics:
F Oversee seamless, high-touch support for senior partners and visiting clients, including boardroom hospitality, local fine-dining coordination, and rapid response requests.
F Coordinate end-to-end logistics for high-profile client workshops, corporate retreats, case study events, and internal networking seminars.
F Supervise the travel desk handling highly fluid, last-minute global itineraries, visa processing, premium hotel partnerships, and corporate card reconciliations.
Compliance & Policy Execution:
F Enforce internal corporate policies, health and safety regulations, fire safety drills, and statutory/legal compliance.
Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting:
F Maintain digital/physical record systems, asset registers, and generate regular operational reports for senior leadership.
Confidentiality & Information Security:
F Enforce strict physical data protection protocols (e.g., clean-desk policies, secure disposal, guest access controls) to safeguard sensitive client project data.
Team Supervision:
F Hire, train, schedule, and evaluate administrative support staff, receptionists, and facilities coordinators.

3. Strong leadership and people management.
4. Vendor negotiation and contract lifecycle management.
5. Problem-solving under pressure and crisis management.
6. Flawless executive communication and stakeholder management.
7. Extreme discretion, emotional intelligence, and professional etiquette.
8. Agility to handle fast-changing schedules and urgent, last-minute requests.

Job Title: Circuit Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.
Validate ASR information before submission to minimize carrier clarifications and rejections.
Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.
Review and process carrier responses, including FOCs and DLRs.
Coordinate with Design, Planning, Implementation, Operations, and carrier teams to resolve ASR-related issues.
Monitor order milestones, due dates, jeopardies, and exceptions.
Maintain accurate order status and documentation throughout the ASR lifecycle.
Escalate carrier delays and provisioning issues as required.
Support circuit installs, changes, migrations, and disconnect requirements.
Maintain appropriate circuit/order information in Granite/XNG or applicable systems.
Required Skills
Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.
Experience using LEC/carrier web ordering tools.(VFO)
Ability to translate network/transport requests into ASR submissions.
Knowledge of TDM and IP network circuit configurations.
Understanding of FOC, DLR, due dates, and carrier provisioning milestones.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge, including PivotTables and formulas.
Good to Have
Experience with PRO/Flightdeck or similar telecom provisioning/inventory tools.
Knowledge of Telecom network architecture and planning.
Experience in carrier/vendor coordination.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Job Title Client Account Lead Manager

Management Level: 07 - Manager

Location: Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Must have skills: Proven track record in sales origination and deal structuring within Communication, Media & Technology industries, Consultative selling expertise

Good to have skills: Stakeholder management with P&L responsibility, Domestic consulting experience is mandatory

Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of sales experience for Communication, Media, software and platforms, Hi Tech focused companies as clients.

Educational Qualification: Masters degree in business administration (MBA) or post graduate degree in management (PGDM)

Job summary
As a Client Account Lead, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, revenue expansion, and client value creation in the domestic India market. This role demands a strong ability to originate and structure deals, build long-term trust with C-suite executives, and position Accenture as a strategic partner for transformation and innovation. You will identify and pursue new opportunities, originate deals, and expand relationships with existing clients in telecom, media, and technology sectors.

Key Responsibilities
Originate and pursue new business opportunities with existing and potential clients in telecom, media, and Software Platforms, Hi Tech \ semiconductor sectors.

Develop compelling proposals and sales presentations, clearly articulating Accentures value proposition and ROI for client operations. Candidate should be able to own clients, drive revenue, and deliver engagements

Build and sustain C-suite relationships, positioning Accenture as a trusted advisor for transformation and innovation agendas.
Drive account growth and profitability, with full ownership of sales targets.
Construct innovative deal solutions, leveraging Accentures consulting and technology capabilities to differentiate in the market.
Ensure robust delivery and consulting for seamless execution of client engagements and maximize client satisfaction.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Proven track record in sales and account management (10+ years), with demonstrated success in revenue growth and deal origination.
Strong C-suite relationship management, with ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic partnerships.

OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.
