Job Description


Overview
Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.
Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


Requirements
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Resources/Environment/Water Management/Hydrology, with 2 to 4 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in any WQ modelling using SWMM, WASP, SWAT, Qual2k, RIOT, HEWRAT, MIKE, SAGIS-SIMCAT, Infoworks ICM.
Strong Data and Statistical analysis skills using Excel, R, SPSS, PowerBI etc.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the Water Quality studies/ Assessments.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall WQ parameters and treatment processes.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits

This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.

Job Summary

Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.

Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.

Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.

Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
5-10 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Your Role
Lead a team of 30 ecologists.
The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of UK clients' requirements and be able to reach back into the business to get the support required to fulfil those requirements and develop relationships/work.
Leading on multi-million capex large projects or frameworks, inputting or overseeing project programmes and budgets.
Collaborating within multi-disciplinary teams and engaging with stakeholders/clients.
The candidate will engage with other areas of the business, seeking opportunities to cross sell and leverage AtkinsRalis' capabilities, preparing bids, supporting on strategic opportunities, building client relationships (internal and external) and driving work-winning in the region.
Undertaking technical checks and reviews of a range of ecological reports and licence applications.
Undertaking ecological assessment and habitat design for a variety of development and nature recovery projects.
Supporting the development of innovative and pragmatic approaches to ecological mitigation and compensation.
Delivering clear and concise, high-quality ecological deliverables in line with current guidance and good practice.
Candidate may coach, mentor and support other staff members in their development.
Task/project management.
About you
A minimum of 15 years of overall professional experience in ecology, including at least 8 years supporting projects in the UK, US, Australia and/or European markets.
An exemplary working knowledge of the UK natural environment and wildlife legislation.
Chartered through the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM), CEcol or CEnv, or actively working towards chartership.
Experience of working on Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects and familiarity with the Development Consent Order (DCO) process would be viewed favourably.
The ability to undertake and provide technical advice on Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Ecological Impact Assessment and Biodiversity Net Gain assessments.
Strong project management experience, including technical delivery, financial management and quality assurance.
Experience in protected species, mitigation and licensing.
Demonstrable experience of bidding and tendering, particularly in the UK region, including work winning and maintaining strong client relationships.

About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.

Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a differenceevery day.
As an ABAP - Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity.

Within our Advisory practice, you will help clients optimize operational efficiency by analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This position offers the opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, while using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing SAP technology installations, configurations, and administration tasks
- Developing and maintaining SAP products and technologies to optimize operational efficiency
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for software development and customization
- Collaborating with teams to drive business transformation and process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori for enhanced data visualization and insights generation
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Applying strategic technology planning to align SAP solutions with client objectives
- Embracing change and fostering innovation within SAP technology projects
- Mentoring junior team members to enhance their technical skills and professional growth

Description:
Greetings from Tech Mahindra!

Job Location: Hyderabad (Hi-Tech City) OR Noida (Sector 62)
Employment Type: Full-Time / Permanent
Number of Openings: 30
Work Mode: 100% Work From Office
Working Days: Monday to Friday (Saturday & Sunday Fixed Off)

About the Opportunity:
Are you an experienced English Teacher, Lecturer or Professor looking to take your teaching career beyond the classroom?

Here is an exciting opportunity to transition into the field of International English Language Assessment and Evaluation. Join a prestigious global English language assessment operations team and work with internationally recognized English language assessment standards. You will collaborate closely with UK-based principal examiners and develop specialized expertise in evaluating English language proficiency across different international standards.

This role also offers an opportunity to progress towards becoming an eligible English Language Assessment Examiner, subject to successfully clearing the required assessments and meeting the applicable eligibility criteria.

Key Responsibilities:
Evaluate and assess students' written responses for international English language certification examinations.
Assess English writing proficiency across CEFR levels A2, B1, B2 and C1.
Apply standardized assessment criteria and marking guidelines to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Maintain high standards of quality, fairness and accuracy throughout the evaluation process.
Work closely with UK-based senior examiners and assessment specialists.
Follow established assessment procedures, quality standards and operational guidelines.
Maintain strict confidentiality and security of examination materials and assessment information.

Eligibility Criteria:
Mandatory Educational Qualifications (Any ONE of the following):
B.Ed. (Bachelor of Education)
B.El.Ed. (Bachelor of Elementary Education)
M.Ed. (Master of Education)
B.A. (Hons) in English
M.A. in English / English Language and Literature
M.Phil. in English / Applied Linguistics / Related Specializations
Ph.D. in English / Applied Linguistics / Related Specializations

Mandatory Teaching Experience:
B.Ed. / M.Ed. candidates: Minimum 1 year of English teaching experience.
B.A. (Hons) / B.El.Ed. / M.A. / M.Phil. / Ph.D. candidates: Minimum 2 years of English teaching experience.

Total Professional Experience: 115 years.

Important Eligibility Conditions:
Candidates must have teaching experience specifically in English.
Teaching experience must be acquired from a recognized school, college or university.
Candidates must possess valid experience letters to substantiate their teaching experience.
Documentary proof of the mandatory teaching experience and educational qualifications is required.
Candidates who do not meet the above qualification and teaching experience criteria will not be eligible.

Work Location & Work Schedule:
Available Locations:
Noida Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh
Hyderabad – Hi-Tech City

Shift Timings:
Noida:
First Shift: 10:30 AM – 8:00 PM
Second Shift: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM
Hyderabad:
First Shift: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM
Second Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:30 PM

Shift Rotation Policy:
All new joiners will initially work in the second shift during the training period.
After successful completion of training, employees will be assigned rotational shifts.
Shifts will rotate once every two months, depending on operational requirements.
Candidates must be comfortable working in both shifts applicable to their respective locations.

Additional Benefits:
Monday to Friday working schedule.
Saturday and Sunday fixed weekly offs.
Free two-way company transportation for all the mentioned shifts.
100% Work From Office.

Compensation & Career Growth:
Attractive salary package based on current CTC, relevant experience and interview performance.
Significant salary enhancement for candidates who successfully meet the applicable eligibility criteria.
Opportunity to develop specialized expertise in international English language assessment.
Potential career progression towards becoming an eligible English Language Assessment Examiner, subject to successful completion of the required assessments.

Relocation Benefits:
Relocation travel assistance for eligible candidates joining from other cities.
Complimentary guest-house accommodation for the first 12 days to support candidates relocating to Hyderabad or Noida.

Selection Process:
Candidates will undergo the following selection stages:
Operations Manager Interview.
Evaluation Test - Using given Marking Rubrics
CEPT Assessment – Listening & Reading.

Candidates must successfully clear the applicable assessment stages to proceed further in the selection process.

Who Should Apply?
We encourage applications from:
Experienced English Teachers.
English Lecturers and Professors.
English Language and Literature Faculty.
English Communication and Language Educators.
Candidates with qualifications in English, Applied Linguistics, TESOL or related disciplines, provided they meet the mandatory qualification and teaching experience criteria.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners

Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.
Skills & Competencies
Business Acumen
Change Management
Conflict Management
Influencing Skills
Labour Relations
Strategy & Risk Management
Stakeholder Management

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing.

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Responsible for the analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory in a given market or cluster.
Position prepares forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections and analyzes the progress of each.
Develops and/or uses analytical tools and systems to maximize revenues and profit.
Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Analyzes information, identifying current and potential problems and proposing solutions.
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Extracts and analyzes data in order to draw viable/actionable business conclusions.
- Provides revenue analysis functional expertise to general managers, property leadership teams and market sales leaders.
- Prepares forecasts of revenue, profit, demand and occupancy for rooms and function space - three-month and six month, long range and budget.
- Prepares revenue and profit opportunity analysis.
- Manages all revenue, profit and demand data associated with rooms and function space.
Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy
- Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.
- Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.
- Understands and accurately represents individual property needs.
- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue analysis processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Promotes and protects brand equity.
- Prepares sales strategy critique.
Building Successful Relationships
- Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.
- Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives and the peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations .
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page (RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc., amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.

Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.

Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Description:
Objective: To achieve the sales (Primary and Secondary), distribution and merchandising objectives for the specified routes, through a team of Market Growth Representatives for a key market (volume and image)
Title: Sales Team Leader
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Rayagada , SORO , Paradadeep
Job Responsibilities:
1. Sales Plan Execution:
a. Coordinate and achieve sales objectives for assigned Territory routes by brand and pack on a daily basis for secondary, primary volumes (Physical Cases & unit Cases), Gross revenue (GR) & Net revenue (NR).
b. Define route plans of the Market Growth Representatives, Account Developers to optimize coverage cost effectively and ensure adequate productivity.
2. Customer Management: Drive Relationship with Outlets through the team of Market growth representative and Account Developers to ensure sustained business.
3. Market Expansion:
a. Drive Horizontal Expansion with respect to number of outlets opened versus target to improve business in the coming years.
b. Take up the responsibility of opening new outlets during market visits and provide necessary support in terms of elements, discounts, coolers etc.
c. Drive conversion of high value/ high visibility outlets to Depth Outlets (Happy Deal, Vision 2020, Teen & College Outlets, Outlets in Emerging Channels) and ensure execution as per Company norms.
d. Market share gain through various ground level interventions such as driving outlet level billing vertically & horizontally.
4. Market Execution: Execute Channel Programmers, Promotional activities for the given set of outlets. Plan for merchandising elements, coolers based on outlets/ market requirements and as per the RED standards. Prepare MGR wise action plans for improving RED (Right Execution) parameters, HE etc.
5. People Management:
a. Carry out on job trainings with Market growth representatives (Off Role) to improve Execution skills on the job. Track PJP (Permanent Journey Plan) Compliance and other productivity Metrics of the team and provide inputs to improve the same via OJT
b. Evaluate performance and skills of MDs and provide inputs via on-the-job coaching, training etc.
c. Conduct Joint Weekly, Monthly Review with ASM to review performance wrt Sales, Execution Parameters of MDs and work on agreed actions.
d. Review Performance and market issues to be resolved via daily Gate Meetings
6. Budget Management:
a. Propose Discount spend for given set of outlets to drive business. Closely monitor customer outstanding and claims and ensure compliance to credit and other policies.
7. Asset Control: Ensure regular tracking of our Assets and ensure asset movements etc in compliance to the Asset Policy.
8. Distribution Management: In routine ensure monitoring distributor ROI, SKU wise margins, DMS (Distribution Management System), scheme spend distributor to market outlets.
Supervises: Market Growth Representatives and Account Developers
Direct Reports: No
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Sales Manager
Business Knowledge: Knowledge of Sales & Distribution preferably in an FMCG Company
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation or MBA
Experience: 4 - 8 years
Travel: Continuous travel within the designated area 80% Travel in a month

Description:
Objective: To achieve the sales (Primary and Secondary), distribution and merchandising objectives for the specified routes, through a team of Market Growth Representatives for a key market (volume and image)
Title: Sales Team Leader
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Dhamanagar , Kamakhyanagar
Job Responsibilities:
1. Sales Plan Execution:
a. Coordinate and achieve sales objectives for assigned Territory routes by brand and pack on a daily basis for secondary, primary volumes (Physical Cases & unit Cases), Gross revenue (GR) & Net revenue (NR).
b. Define route plans of the Market Growth Representatives, Account Developers to optimize coverage cost effectively and ensure adequate productivity.
2. Customer Management: Drive Relationship with Outlets through the team of Market growth representative and Account Developers to ensure sustained business.
3. Market Expansion:
a. Drive Horizontal Expansion with respect to number of outlets opened versus target to improve business in the coming years.
b. Take up the responsibility of opening new outlets during market visits and provide necessary support in terms of elements, discounts, coolers etc.
c. Drive conversion of high value/ high visibility outlets to Depth Outlets (Happy Deal, Vision 2020, Teen & College Outlets, Outlets in Emerging Channels) and ensure execution as per Company norms.
d. Market share gain through various ground level interventions such as driving outlet level billing vertically & horizontally.
4. Market Execution: Execute Channel Programmers, Promotional activities for the given set of outlets. Plan for merchandising elements, coolers based on outlets/ market requirements and as per the RED standards. Prepare MGR wise action plans for improving RED (Right Execution) parameters, HE etc.
5. People Management:
a. Carry out on job trainings with Market growth representatives (Off Role) to improve Execution skills on the job. Track PJP (Permanent Journey Plan) Compliance and other productivity Metrics of the team and provide inputs to improve the same via OJT
b. Evaluate performance and skills of MDs and provide inputs via on-the-job coaching, training etc.
c. Conduct Joint Weekly, Monthly Review with ASM to review performance wrt Sales, Execution Parameters of MDs and work on agreed actions.
d. Review Performance and market issues to be resolved via daily Gate Meetings
6. Budget Management:
a. Propose Discount spend for given set of outlets to drive business. Closely monitor customer outstanding and claims and ensure compliance to credit and other policies.
7. Asset Control: Ensure regular tracking of our Assets and ensure asset movements etc in compliance to the Asset Policy.
8. Distribution Management: In routine ensure monitoring distributor ROI, SKU wise margins, DMS (Distribution Management System), scheme spend distributor to market outlets.
Supervises: Market Growth Representatives and Account Developers
Direct Reports: No
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Sales Manager
Business Knowledge: Knowledge of Sales & Distribution preferably in an FMCG Company
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation or MBA
Experience: 4 - 8 years
Travel: Continuous travel within the designated area 80% Travel in a month

Proficient in SAP S/4HANA and Advanced Excel.
Exposure to manufacturing/large corporate environments preferred.
IFRS or Ind AS certification will be an added advantage.

OverviewA Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline

Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician. Completes all required on the job training hours. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities . Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development. 1. Key Skills Required
DG Set Testing Commissioning - hands-on experience in DG/engine testing.
Electrical Troubleshooting - ability to identify and rectify faults in electrical circuits, panels, wiring and protection systems.
Electrical Electronic Systems - good understanding of AC/DC circuits, sensors, relays, contactors, breakers and control systems.
Engine Electronics - basic understanding of ECU, ECM, sensors, actuators and electronic control systems.
Test Instruments - proficient in using multimeter, clamp meter, megger/insulation tester and other electrical measuring instruments.
Electrical Drawing Reading - ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and circuit diagrams.
Control Panel Knowledge - troubleshooting of DG control panels, protection circuits and monitoring systems.
Test Cell Operations - understanding of engine/DG test procedures, parameters and test-cell equipment.
Problem Solving RCA - ability to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Safety Knowledge - strong knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, PPE and safe working practices.
Documentation - maintaining test reports, check sheets, troubleshooting records and equipment history.
Computer Skills - basic MS Office/Excel and ability to work with digital testing/monitoring systems.
2. Roles Responsibilities
DG Testing Operations
Perform DG/engine testing as per defined test procedures and specifications.
Carry out pre-test inspection and verify electrical connections before starting the test.
Monitor key electrical and engine parameters during testing.
Ensure timely completion of testing to support engine dispatch requirements.
Identify abnormalities during testing and take appropriate corrective action.
Electrical Electronics Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues during engine/DG testing.
Diagnose issues related to sensors, wiring, ECU/ECM, control panels, relays, contactors, breakers and protection circuits.
Use appropriate diagnostic and electrical test equipment for fault finding.
Coordinate with Maintenance/Engineering teams for complex issues.
Quality Documentation
Ensure testing is performed as per SOP, Control Plan and Quality requirements.
Record test results accurately and maintain all required documentation.
Escalate test failures and abnormal conditions promptly.
Support RCA and corrective/preventive actions for recurring failures.
Safety
Follow all electrical and test-cell safety requirements.
Ensure proper LOTO, grounding, PPE and safe isolation before electrical intervention.
Immediately report unsafe conditions and near misses.
Maintain 5S and housekeeping in the test-cell area.
Continuous Improvement

Wipro is seeking an AI Engineer to implement and test agent nodes on a production Agentic AI platform for a large-scale healthcare technology engagement. You will work within an established LangGraph architecture, building individual agent nodes, tool integrations, and LLM-powered processing steps under the technical direction of the Senior AI Engineer and AI Architect. Implement individual LangGraph agent nodes per agreed specifications: data retrieval, clinical assessment, evidence gathering, decision evaluation, and recommendation.

Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker patterns within agent nodes.
Instrument nodes with OpenTelemetry spans and structured audit log events.
Write unit and integration tests for all implemented nodes and tool integrations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards within the team.
Support integration testing, debugging, and defect resolution through the testing phase.

Required Skills & Experience
5+ years software engineering experience; 3+ year working with LLM APIs or AI application development.
Python: async programming, REST API consumption, clean modular code.
LLM integration: experience calling LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalent); function/tool calling, prompt construction, response parsing.
LangGraph or LangChain: working knowledge of agent node patterns, state management, and tool use. Production experience a strong plus.
Azure fundamentals: containerized workloads on AKS, Azure services consumption.
Testing discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and test-driven development practices.
Comfortable working within a defined architecture under senior technical direction.

Preferred Skills
Healthcare or regulated industry exposure: HIPAA awareness, PHI handling, clinical data types.
Familiarity with clinical coding systems: RxNorm, CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED-CT.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, or event-driven architectures.

Strong exposure to procurement of project packages, contracts, MRO items, spares, and consumables.
Proven experience in independently handling the complete procurement cycle.
Sound understanding of commercial contracts and major contractual clauses.
Advanced hands-on experience in SAP MM.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel.
Experience in techno-commercial evaluation and vendor negotiations.

Summary:

- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
