Description:
Role and Responsibilities:
1. Supplier Quality Management
Evaluate and approve new suppliers. Conduct supplier audits and assessments. Monitor supplier performance using quality metrics (PPM, defect rates, delivery quality, etc.). Develop supplier improvement plans when quality issues arise.
2. Incoming Material Quality Assurance
Verify that incoming parts and materials meet specifications. Review inspection reports and quality documentation.
Coordinate with incoming quality inspection teams. Manage containment actions for non-conforming materials.
3. APQP and PPAP Activities
Participate in Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities. Review and approve Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions from suppliers. Ensure suppliers comply with customer-specific requirements during product development.
4. Problem Solving and Corrective Actions
Lead investigations of supplier-related defects. Use quality tools such as:
8D Methodology, 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram, Pareto Analysis, FMEA
Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.
5. Process Audits
Conduct supplier process audits. Verify compliance with: IATF 16949 requirements ISO 9001 standards, Customer-specific requirements, Assess manufacturing controls, traceability, and process capability.
6. Quality Data Analysis
Analyze warranty, field failure, and production defect data.
Track KPIs such as: PPM (Parts Per Million defects). Supplier Scorecard Ratings, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
Audit Findings, Generate quality reports and improvement recommendations.
7. Change Management
Review supplier process changes.
Approve changes in: Manufacturing processes, Raw materials, Tooling, Production locations and Ensure proper validation before implementation.
8. Customer Complaint Support
Support investigations related to supplier-caused customer complaints. Coordinate with suppliers for root cause analysis and corrective actions. Provide quality documentation to customers when required.
9. Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with: , Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Purchasing/Sourcing, Production, Logistics, Suppliers
Customer Quality Teams, Skills Required
The SQA Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the quality of software products through comprehensive testing and validation processes. The role involves developing and executing test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating with the development team to enhance product quality. The SQA Engineer will participate in the entire software development lifecycle, providing insights and recommendations to improve testing methodologies and processes.

Description:
Receptionist / Front Desk Executive
Company: Boondh Healing Caf & Wellness Centre
Location: Cool Road, Jalandhar
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
About the Role
We are looking for a warm, organised and professional Receptionist to be the first point of contact for guests at Boondh. The role involves welcoming visitors, managing appointments, handling enquiries and coordinating with our caf and wellness teams to create a smooth, comfortable guest experience.
Roles and Responsibilities
Welcome guests courteously and guide them to the appropriate service or team member.
Handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages and walk-in enquiries promptly.
Schedule, confirm and reschedule appointments for therapies, meditation sessions, yoga classes and consultations.
Explain available services, packages, memberships and ongoing offers accurately.
Maintain appointment calendars and coordinate with therapists, instructors and management.
Assist guests with registrations, booking systems and feedback.
Manage billing, receive payments, issue receipts and maintain accurate daily records.
Maintain guest records carefully and protect personal information.
Handle guest concerns calmly and escalate issues when required.
Keep the reception area tidy, welcoming and organised.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Previous experience in reception, front office, hospitality, a salon, spa or wellness centre is preferred. Freshers with strong communication skills may also apply.
Good communication skills in Hindi and English; Punjabi is an advantage.
Comfortable using computers, WhatsApp, email, basic Excel and booking or billing software.
Polite telephone etiquette, professional presentation and a guest-focused attitude.
Punctual, dependable and able to manage multiple appointments and enquiries.
Comfortable working scheduled shifts, including weekends as required.
Salary and Benefits
Salary based on relevant experience and skills.
Opportunity to learn front-office operations in a caf and wellness environment.
Further employment terms and applicable benefits will be discussed during the interview.
AboutCompany:
Boondh is a healing caf and wellness centre on Cool Road, Jalandhar, founded by author and Emotional Intelligence trainer Neha Arora.
Bringing together a caf, yoga, guided meditation, sound healing, relaxation therapies and personalised consultations, Boondh offers a welcoming space for people to pause, reconnect with themselves and nurture their well-being.
Our philosophy is simple: “Every drop heals.” We believe thoughtful experiences, compassionate service and small moments of care can make a meaningful difference.
We are building a team that values warmth, professionalism, respect and genuine care for every guest.

Designation: Spa & Wellness Therapist
Company: Boondh Healing Caf & Wellness Centre
Location: Cool Road, Jalandhar
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled, caring and professional therapist to deliver wellness and relaxation therapies at Boondh. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in body therapies, excellent hygiene standards and a respectful approach to guest comfort and privacy.
Roles and Responsibilities
Perform body massage and wellness therapies within your training and qualifications.
Deliver treatments such as Abhyanga, Shirodhara, potli therapy, hot stone massage, and bamboo therapy according to demonstrated expertise and approved protocols.
Discuss guest preferences, allergies and relevant health information before each session; identify contraindications and seek guidance when a treatment may be unsuitable.
Explain the treatment, obtain consent and check guest comfort throughout the session.
Maintain professional boundaries, appropriate draping and guest privacy at all times.
Prepare treatment rooms, oils, towels and equipment before each appointment.
Follow safe procedures for oil temperatures, heated equipment and treatment duration.
Clean and sanitise equipment and treatment areas, and replace linen after every guest.
Maintain accurate treatment records and keep guest information confidential.
Coordinate with reception regarding appointments, room readiness and session timings.
Monitor supplies and report equipment issues or guest concerns promptly.
Provide simple aftercare guidance within the scope of your training.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Recognised training or certification in spa therapies, massage, Ayurveda therapies or a related discipline.
Preferably 1–3 years of practical experience in a spa, wellness centre, resort or Ayurveda centre.
Hands-on expertise in one or more of the therapies listed above; applicants should clearly mention their specialisations.
Knowledge of hygiene, contraindications, safe treatment practices and guest care.
Calm, courteous, punctual and dependable.
Good communication skills in Hindi or Punjabi; basic English is an advantage.
Willingness to undergo a practical skills assessment and learn Boondh’s service standards.
Comfortable working scheduled shifts, including weekends as required.
Salary and Benefits
Salary based on qualifications, practical skills and experience.
Opportunities for learning and professional development.
Other applicable benefits and employment terms will be discussed during the interview.
AboutCompany:
Boondh is a healing caf and wellness centre on Cool Road, Jalandhar, founded by author and Emotional Intelligence trainer Neha Arora.
Bringing together a caf, yoga, guided meditation, sound healing, relaxation therapies and personalised consultations, Boondh offers a welcoming space for people to pause, reconnect with themselves and nurture their well-being.
Our philosophy is simple: “Every drop heals.” We believe thoughtful experiences, compassionate service and small moments of care can make a meaningful difference.
We are building a team that values warmth, professionalism, respect and genuine care for every guest.

Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates with strong hands-on experience in milk procurement and direct farmer management, particularly from the dairy / Agri / Food industry.

Preference: Candidates who have handled large-scale milk procurement operations and farmer networks at a zonal/regional level, with strong field exposure and team-management experience.

Role & responsibilities
Lead milk procurement operations across the assigned zone.
Strengthen relationships with farmers, Milk Collection Centres (MCCs), and procurement teams.
Drive milk volume, quality and procurement efficiency across the zone.
Develop and implement strategies for farmer engagement, retention and milk productivity.
Monitor milk procurement, quality parameters, pricing, cost and daily procurement performance.
Ensure effective functioning of MCCs, BMCs and milk collection infrastructure.
Coordinate with Veterinary, Dairy Development, QA, Operations, Logistics and Sales teams as required.
Identify opportunities to improve farmer base, procurement coverage and milk availability.
Lead and develop the Zone 4 procurement team and ensure accountability for targets.
Monitor market conditions impacting milk procurement.
Drive initiatives for farmer loyalty, productivity enhancement and sustainable milk sourcing.

Must-have:
Experience in milk procurement / farmer relationship management.
Strong exposure to village-level milk collection and farmer networks.
Experience managing milk procurement teams and operations at a regional/zonal level.
Good understanding of milk quality, procurement processes and farmer engagement.
Fluency in Punjabi/Hindi is mandatory, with the ability to communicate effectively with local farmers and stakeholders.
Strong field orientation and willingness to extensively engage with the farmer community.
AboutCompany:
We are one of the Leading Private Dairy Players in India with a Chilling Capacity of 1.95 million litres per day, Processing Capacity of 2.57 million litres per day and Packaging Capacity of 1.71 million litres per day. By deeply committing ourselves to innovation and to providing authentic, high-quality milk products, we have grown multifold to occupy a sizeable share in India's Dairy Market.
We process and market a full line of dairy products including fresh milk, curd, buttermilk, lassi, ice-cream, paneer, ghee, table butter, cooking butter, milk powder, flavored milk, UHT milk and dairy whitener. Headquartered in Hyderabad, we have a significant presence in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharastra, Odisha, NCR Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand & Uttar Pradesh.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead Manufacturing Engineering and MES activities covering process development, process optimization, automation, OEE improvement, manufacturing system digitalization and continuous improvement.
The role will ensure safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective manufacturing processes through robust process engineering, MES utilization, automation and data-driven improvement. The position will work closely with Production, Quality, RD, Maintenance, IT and other cross-functional teams to achieve manufacturing objectives.
Key Areas
Process Engineering | MES | Automation | OEE | Lean Manufacturing | Process Improvement
Key Responsibilities Process Manufacturing Engineering
1. Develop and continuously improve manufacturing processes for existing products, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and process stability.
2. Develop and maintain Process Flow Charts, PFC/PFD, SOPs, Work Instructions, Control Plans and other manufacturing documentation.
3. Define process parameters, standard work and manufacturing controls.
4. Conduct process validation and establish robust manufacturing processes.
5. Improve process capability, OEE, yield, cycle time, equipment utilization and manufacturing cost.
6. Develop and implement tooling, fixtures, gauges, jigs and Poka-Yoke solutions.
7. Support Production, Quality and RD teams in resolving process, manufacturability and product-related manufacturing issues.
8. Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring manufacturing problems.
MES - Manufacturing Execution System
1. Lead and support the operation and continuous improvement of the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
2. Define and maintain manufacturing processes, routing, operations, workstations and production workflows within MES.
3. Manage MES master data including product, process, routing, BOM and production-related information as applicable.
4. Implement electronic work instructions, digital SOPs and process controls through MES.
5. Establish real-time production data collection for output, rejection, downtime, cycle time, process status and operator activity.
6. Establish product and process traceability from raw material through finished goods.
7. Support integration of MES with ERP/SAP, machines, PLCs, testers, scanners and other shop-floor systems.
8. Monitor MES data accuracy and ensure alignment between actual shop-floor processes and system transactions.
9. Develop MES dashboards and reports for OEE, downtime, rejection, FPY and manufacturing performance.
10. Analyze MES data to identify process losses, equipment issues and opportunities for improvement.
11. Coordinate with IT, MES developers and external system integrators for troubleshooting, enhancements and system upgrades.
12. Conduct MES user training, UAT, system validation and implementation support.
13. Ensure controlled MES changes through ECN/change-management procedures.
Automation Process Improvement
1. Identify and implement automation and semi-automation opportunities to improve quality, safety and process efficiency.
2. Lead Low-Cost Automation (LCA), robotics, sensors, interlocks and automated inspection projects.
3. Implement Poka-Yoke and process-monitoring solutions to prevent manufacturing defects.
4. Reduce manual dependency, cycle time, scrap, rework and process losses through engineering improvements.
5. Improve material flow, workstation design, ergonomics and operator movement through process improvements.
6. Drive Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing projects with measurable quality, cost and process benefits.
7. Evaluate process simulation opportunities using tools such as FlexSim for process optimization.
8. Support Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing initiatives through digital data collection and real-time monitoring.
OEE Equipment Performance
1. Monitor and improve OEE across manufacturing equipment and production processes.
2. Analyze Availability, Performance and Quality losses to identify major sources of equipment inefficiency.
3. Analyze the Six Big Losses and coordinate corrective actions with Production and Maintenance teams.
4. Identify recurring equipment and process losses and implement permanent corrective actions.
5. Improve equipment utilization, process stability, cycle time and machine performance.
6. Develop and monitor equipment and process performance dashboards through MES.
7. Support Production and Maintenance teams in reducing downtime, minor stoppages and process-related losses.
Quality, Safety Process Control
1. Develop and maintain PFMEA, Control Plan, SOP and process-control documentation.
2. Ensure manufacturing processes are properly controlled and consistently followed on the shop floor.
3. Conduct HIRA and ergonomic assessments for new and existing workstations.
4. Apply REBA and other ergonomic assessment methods to reduce operator risk.
5. Evaluate quality, safety and environmental impacts of manufacturing process changes.
6. Implement Poka-Yoke, interlocks and process controls to prevent defects and unsafe conditions.
7. Support internal, customer and certification audits related to manufacturing processes.
Cross-Functional Coordination
1. Coordinate with Production, Quality, RD, Testing, Maintenance, SMT, Warehouse, Material Control, SQM, IT and other cross-functional teams.
2. Lead technical discussions related to process improvement, automation, MES and manufacturing system improvements.
3. Coordinate with automation, machine, tooling and MES suppliers.
4. Prepare improvement plans, action plans, technical reviews and progress reports.
5. Support implementation of manufacturing engineering and digitalization projects within defined scope and timelines.
Key Deliverables
1. Manufacturing Process Development Optimization
2. MES Management Digital Manufacturing
3. Automation Process Improvement
4. OEE Equipment Performance Improvement
5. Process Control Manufacturing Documentation
6. Poka-Yoke Low-Cost Automation
7. Lean Manufacturing Kaizen
8. Manufacturing Data Analytics Performance Monitoring
9. Industry 4.0 Shop-Floor Digitalization
10. Reduction of Process Losses, Scrap and Rework
Key Performance Indicators
1. OEE and equipment performance improvement
2. Process capability and yield improvement
3. Reduction in scrap, rejection and rework
4. Reduction in equipment downtime and process losses
5. Cycle-time and process-efficiency improvement
6. MES data accuracy, traceability and system utilization
7. MES system performance and user adoption
8. Successful implementation of automation and Poka-Yoke solutions
9. Manufacturing cost reduction through process improvement
10. Kaizen and continuous improvement results
11. Improvement in FPY and process stability
12. Reduction in Six Big Losses
Qualification Experience
1. Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing / Electrical Engineering.
2. Experience: 6-10 years of relevant Manufacturing / Process Engineering experience.
3. Experience preferably in Electronics, Automotive, Electrical, EMS or high-volume manufacturing.
4. Hands-on experience in Manufacturing Engineering and process optimization.
5. Experience in MES operation, implementation, improvement or digital manufacturing systems.
6. Experience in automation, process improvement and continuous improvement projects.
7. Strong experience in shop-floor problem solving and manufacturing process control.
Required Technical Knowledge
1. Manufacturing Engineering: Process development, process validation, SOP, PFC/PFD, PFMEA and Control Plan.
2. MES: Production tracking, routing, traceability, electronic work instructions, data collection, dashboards and ERP/MES integration.
3. OEE: Availability, Performance, Quality and Six Big Losses analysis.
4. Automation: Low-Cost Automation, robotics, sensors, interlocks, Poka-Yoke and automated inspection.
5. Lean Manufacturing: Kaizen, DMAIC, DMADV, VSM, 5S/6S and waste elimination.
6. Process Improvement: Root Cause Analysis, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and process capability analysis.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead manufacturing engineering activities for coil shop, press shop and associated manufacturing processes, covering process development, equipment development, automation, productivity improvement, tooling, CAPEX and new product industrialization. The role will ensure safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective manufacturing processes and work closely with Production, Quality, RD and Maintenance to achieve manufacturing objectives.
Experience: 5-10 Years
Responsibilities
process engineering
1. Develop and continuously improve manufacturing processes for Coil Shop, Press Shop and related operations, ensuring quality, safety, productivity and process stability.
2. Define process parameters, controls, standard work and manufacturing requirements and ensure effective process validation.
3. Improve process capability, OEE, productivity, yield, cycle time, equipment reliability and manufacturing cost.
4. Develop and implement appropriate tooling, fixtures, gauges and Poka-Yoke solutions for critical manufacturing operations.
5. Support Production, Quality and RD in resolving process, manufacturability and product-related manufacturing issues.
COIL SHOP engineering
1. Develop and optimize evaporator and condenser coil manufacturing processes, including tube cutting, hairpin/U-bend, fin forming, tube insertion, expansion, assembly, brazing and leak testing.
2. Establish and optimize critical process parameters, equipment capability and process controls to achieve required quality, yield, cycle time and reliability.
3. Support development and validation of coil tooling, fixtures, gauges, jigs and Poka-Yoke, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
4. Improve material utilization, tube/fin handling, brazing quality, leakage performance, equipment efficiency and process stability.
5. Analyze coil manufacturing defects and process losses and implement corrective actions for issues related to dimensions, insertion, expansion, brazing, leakage, fin damage and assembly.
press SHOP engineering
1. Develop and optimize sheet-metal manufacturing processes, including blanking, stamping, punching, bending, forming, piercing and related press operations.
2. Support selection and development of press machines, dies, tools, fixtures and gauges, including die trials, process validation and production stabilization.
3. Review component drawings for manufacturability and provide inputs on material, process sequence, tooling feasibility, tolerances and quality requirements.
4. Improve press-shop performance through better material utilization, tool/die life, cycle time, quality, equipment efficiency and process stability.
5. Identify and resolve manufacturing defects such as dimensional variation, burrs, cracks, deformation, wrinkles, spring-back and other forming-related issues.
automation productivity improvement
1. Identify and implement automation and semi-automation opportunities across Coil Shop, Press Shop and related manufacturing processes.
2. Drive improvements in OEE, productivity, cycle time, yield, equipment performance and process efficiency.
3. Implement Poka-Yoke, sensors, interlocks, automated inspection, traceability and suitable process-monitoring solutions.
4. Reduce manual dependency, scrap, rework, process losses and manufacturing cost through engineering improvements.
5. Lead Lean, Kaizen, 5S and continuous improvement projects with measurable productivity and quality benefits.
capex equipment engineering
1. Lead CAPEX projects for new equipment, automation, tooling and process improvements.
2. Prepare URS and technical specifications and evaluate technical proposals from equipment, tooling and automation suppliers.
3. Coordinate equipment development through design reviews, FAT, installation, commissioning, trials, validation and handover.
4. Ensure equipment meets defined requirements for quality, safety, reliability, productivity and performance.
5. Manage supplier technical coordination and ensure projects are completed within approved requirements, timelines and budgets.
NEW product industrialization
1. Support RD in new product industrialization and manufacturing readiness.
2. Participate in DFMA / manufacturability reviews and identify process, tooling and equipment risks.
3. Define manufacturing process, tooling, fixture and equipment requirements for new products.
4. Support prototype, pilot and pre-production trials and process validation.
5. Ensure manufacturing readiness and support successful production ramp-up before mass production.
Key Deliverables
Manufacturing Process Development Improvement
Coil Shop Press Shop Process Engineering
Tooling, Fixtures, Dies, Gauges Poka-Yoke
Automation, Productivity CAPEX Projects
New Product Manufacturing Readiness Process Validation
Key Performance Indicators
OEE, equipment performance and productivity
Process capability, yield and FPY improvement
Reduction in scrap, rework and manufacturing losses
Successful equipment commissioning and CAPEX completion
Manufacturing cost reduction and successful new product industrialization
Qualification Experience
Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience: 10-12 years of relevant Manufacturing / Process Engineering experience.
Experience preferably in Air Conditioner, HVAC, Refrigeration,
Hands-on experience in Coil Shop and Press Shop manufacturing processes.
Experience in equipment development, automation, CAPEX and new product industrialization.
Required Technical Knowledge
Coil Manufacturing: Tube, fin, hairpin/U-bend, insertion, expansion, brazing, assembly and leak testing.
Press Shop: Stamping, blanking, punching, bending, forming, dies, tooling and sheet-metal processes.
Equipment Development, Manufacturing CAPEX, commissioning and supplier management.
Automation / Semi-Automation, OEE and Productivity Improvement.
Lean Manufacturing, Poka-Yoke, Process Validation and Root Cause Analysis.
Core Competencies
Strong Manufacturing and Process Engineering knowledge.
Strong hands-on understanding of Coil Shop and Press Shop operations.
Strong problem-solving and technical project-management skills.
Ability to manage equipment suppliers and cross-functional engineering projects.
Ability to drive quality, productivity, reliability and manufacturing cost improvement.

Roles & Responsibilites

1. Equipment Operation & Maintenance
Perform operation, inspection, and maintenance of:
Mixers, crushers, and size reduction equipment
Screw conveyors and chain conveyors
Coal handling systems including feeders, conveyors, and transfer points
Silos and bulk material storage systems
Storage tanks (water, fuel, chemicals)
Ensure proper alignment, balancing, lubrication, and calibration of rotating equipment.
Monitor equipment performance parameters and take corrective actions.
2. Boiler & Utility Systems
Operate and maintain boilers and associated auxiliaries (pumps, valves, pipelines).
Monitor steam generation, pressure, and temperature parameters.
Maintain water treatment systems including R.O (Reverse Osmosis) plants.
Ensure efficient operation of compressors (air systems) and hydraulic pumps.
3. Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems
Maintain and troubleshoot hydraulic pumps, actuators, and control systems.
Diagnose issues in pneumatic systems connected to compressors and valves.
Ensure leak-free operation and proper pressure settings.
4. Material Handling & Lifting Equipment
Inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot cranes and overhead (EOT) cranes.
Ensure safe handling of heavy materials and compliance with lifting standards.
Coordinate with operations team for material movement efficiency.
5. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all plant equipment.
Implement predictive maintenance techniques such as vibration analysis and thermography.
Maintain maintenance logs, history records, and equipment documentation.
Analyze recurring failures and implement root cause analysis (RCA).
6. Breakdown Management
Respond to equipment breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime.
Identify root causes and implement permanent corrective actions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for quick resolution.

7. Safety, Quality & Compliance
Ensure strict adherence to safety standards and statutory regulations.
Conduct risk assessments, safety audits, and toolbox talks.
Follow SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and quality guidelines.
Ensure safe handling of hazardous materials and high-pressure systems.
8. Team Coordination & Reporting
Supervise technicians and maintenance staff.
Coordinate with electrical, instrumentation, and operations teams.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Train junior staff on equipment handling and safety procedures.
Qualifications
Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Experience
8–10+ years in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferably from AAC Blocks Manufacturing

Financial Outcomes
Drive primary and secondary sales delivery for the assigned territory by ensuring achievement of volume, value, distribution,

interventions.
Foster a high-performance culture through performance reviews, recognition, and continuous feedback.
Identify and implement best practices, local market initiatives, and innovative approaches to improve business outcomes.
Develop a strong talent pipeline by mentoring team members and supporting succession readiness within the territory.

MBA/ Similar degree

Development skills
Team management experience

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Business Manager Livspace Casantro
Experience: 6–12 Years
Industry: Interior Design | Architecture | Home Interiors
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role
Livspace Casantro is looking for an accomplished and result-oriented Business Manager to lead its design team and drive business performance.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in interior design, team leadership, project management, and business development, with the ability to manage the complete project lifecycle while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.
This role requires a dynamic leader who can build high-performing design teams, improve operational efficiency, drive conversions, and ensure seamless project execution.
Key Responsibilities
1. Design Team Leadership
Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Architects and Interior Designers.
Drive team productivity, performance, and accountability.
Recruit, onboard, train, and develop design talent.
Strengthen the team's technical knowledge, design capabilities, and customer-handling skills.
2. Business & Funnel Management
Own and manage the complete project funnel, from order booking to production readiness.
Drive business conversion, order booking, and revenue targets.
Monitor project progress, funnel health, and team performance.
Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve business outcomes.
3. Project & Operational Management
Ensure timely movement of projects through design, approvals, and production readiness.
Coordinate with production, operations, procurement, and installation teams.
Maintain quality standards and ensure smooth project handovers.
Resolve escalations and ensure timely project closures.
4. Customer Experience
Drive exceptional customer satisfaction throughout the project journey.
Maintain a customer NPS of 9+/10.
Handle critical customer escalations and ensure effective resolution.
Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and ownership.
Desired Candidate Profile
Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's degree in Interior Design or B.Arch.
Minimum 6+ years of experience in interior design and project management.
Mandatory experience in managing and leading a team of Architects / Interior Designers.
Proven track record of successfully delivering at least 10 residential interior projects end to end.
Strong understanding of residential interiors, design concepts, materials, and execution processes.
Excellent business acumen, funnel management, and conversion capabilities.
Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and drive teams towards business objectives.
Added Advantage: Experience in building, developing, and scaling design teams in a fast-growing interior design organization.
Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
Business conversion and order booking.
Design team productivity and performance.
Project funnel management and production readiness.
Customer satisfaction and NPS of 9+/10.
Project quality, timelines, and operational efficiency.
Team hiring, retention, and capability development.
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to lead and scale a high-performing design team.
Work in a fast-growing home interiors business.
Drive business growth while delivering exceptional customer experiences.
Build your leadership career in the interior design industry.
Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resume.Role & responsibilities

Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Sales Executive General Trade to handle and grow the packaged drinking water business in Andhra Pradesh. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, managing distributors, increasing outlet coverage, and improving product availability and visibility in the market.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Sales & Market Growth
Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets for the Coimbatore market
Drive primary and secondary sales through distributors and retail outlets.
Increase the number of active retail outlets in the assigned area.
2. Market Development & Visibility
Ensure products are available in all key retail outlets.
Improve shelf display and brand visibility in shops.
Execute trade schemes, promotions, and in-store activities.
Identify new areas and outlets for business growth.
3. Distributor & Channel Management
Manage distributors and support them in daily operations.
Plan orders and ensure timely delivery to retailers.
Monitor distributor stock levels and secondary sales.
Resolve distributor and retailer issues quickly.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with key retailers and wholesalers.
Address service complaints and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain long-term business relationships with trade partners.
5. Market Intelligence & Reporting
Track competitor pricing, schemes, and activities in the market.
Collect feedback from retailers and consumers.
Share market updates and sales reports with management regularly.
6. Collections & Compliance
Ensure timely collection of payments from distributors and retailers.
Maintain accurate sales, stock, and collection records.
Follow company policies and reporting guidelines.

Qualifications & Skills:
Education: Graduate in any discipline or a related field.
Experience: 4 - 10 years of experience in FMCG, beverages, or packaged drinking water sales.

Expertise
Strong experience in General Trade and distributor handling.
Candidates with experience in the relevant geographic location and exposure to nearby markets will be preferred.
Two-wheeler with a valid driving license is mandatory.
AboutCompany: Bisleri is the leading brand in the bottled water industry. We are the pioneers, having a nation wide network for manufacturing, sales and distribution.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Sales Executive General Trade to handle and grow the packaged drinking water business in Andhra Pradesh. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, managing distributors, increasing outlet coverage, and improving product availability and visibility in the market.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Sales & Market Growth
Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets for the Coimbatore market
Drive primary and secondary sales through distributors and retail outlets.
Increase the number of active retail outlets in the assigned area.
2. Market Development & Visibility
Ensure products are available in all key retail outlets.
Improve shelf display and brand visibility in shops.
Execute trade schemes, promotions, and in-store activities.
Identify new areas and outlets for business growth.
3. Distributor & Channel Management
Manage distributors and support them in daily operations.
Plan orders and ensure timely delivery to retailers.
Monitor distributor stock levels and secondary sales.
Resolve distributor and retailer issues quickly.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with key retailers and wholesalers.
Address service complaints and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain long-term business relationships with trade partners.
5. Market Intelligence & Reporting
Track competitor pricing, schemes, and activities in the market.
Collect feedback from retailers and consumers.
Share market updates and sales reports with management regularly.
6. Collections & Compliance
Ensure timely collection of payments from distributors and retailers.
Maintain accurate sales, stock, and collection records.
Follow company policies and reporting guidelines.

Qualifications & Skills:
Education: Graduate in any discipline or a related field.
Experience: 4 - 10 years of experience in FMCG, beverages, or packaged drinking water sales.

Expertise
Strong experience in General Trade and distributor handling.
Candidates with experience in the relevant geographic location and exposure to nearby markets will be preferred.
Two-wheeler with a valid driving license is mandatory.

Description:
Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

Job Description: The Customer Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers and rider partners, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries.
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options.
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements.
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels.
Handling customer and rider partner escalations-preparing RCA and providing the solution.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts.
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements and providing best solutions to the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Required Skills:
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and rider partners and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment - this is applicable for our rider partners as well
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer and rider partner issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer and rider related issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job Description Senior Manager Maintenance (Optical Fiber Cable Plant)

Position
Senior Manager Maintenance

Department
Engineering & Maintenance

Location -Verna, South Goa

Qualification

MBA (Preferred)

Experience

Job Purpose

To lead the Maintenance function of the Optical Fiber Cable Plant by ensuring maximum machine availability, improving equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, managing utilities, and driving continuous improvement through preventive and predictive maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utility, and Automation maintenance activities.
Ensure maximum uptime of OFC manufacturing machines through effective preventive and predictive maintenance.
Handle breakdown analysis and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Plan and execute annual shutdowns and major maintenance activities.
Maintain critical utilities including Compressors, Chillers, HVAC, DG Sets, Transformers, HT/LT Systems, Air Dryers, Water Systems, and Power Distribution.
Maintain and troubleshoot OFC manufacturing equipment including:
Fiber Coloring Lines
Ribbonizing Lines
SZ Stranding Machines
Buffering Lines
Sheathing/Jacketing Extrusion Lines
Armouring Lines
Rewinding & Take-up Systems

Designation: Executive / Sr. Executive Quality
Roles & Responsibilities:
Responsible for quality of products manufactured in the Unit. Assure 100% quality of products supplied to market conforms to company specification and regulatory norms.
Responsible for food safety, quality systems meeting regulatory norms under various food regulations.
Ensure conformance to ISO 22000 in Plant.
To ensure daily / weekly / monthly tests as per quality standards of the company and also as per statutory norms.
Timely Verification of Records.
Ensure testing of all incoming materials like Cartons, Labels, Preforms and Blown Bottles. Ensuring quality of all RM/PM. To supervise online testing for (Fill Height, Label position, Bottle blown, Carton packing). In case of any non-compliance, corrective actions are to be taken.
Ensure the team is handling all market complaints and carry out analysis of the same for finding out the root cause. Accurate corrective actions are taken accordingly. To Analyse market replacements/ Customer Complaints/ follow up of corrective action.
Analysis of Online defects and trend analysis.
To ensure micro analysis of raw water and product water on daily basis to ensure product quality. In case of any water contamination, analyse the root cause & take corrective action.
Ensure periodic calibration of all testing equipment meeting to standards
Ensure availability of consumables including micron filters, R.O. chemicals and lab chemicals for water treatment and sanitation and strict adherence to RO/WTP maintenance schedule.
Monitoring of Pest Control activity.
Conduct routine checks on hygiene, sanitation, and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) across the production and packaging areas.
Maintain accurate records related to CCPs, cleaning schedules, pest control, and food safety checklists as per regulatory and audit requirements. Coordinate with the QA team to conduct food safety training and ensure adherence to SOPs by shop-floor staff.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Video Producer who is passionate about shooting and editing films, advertisements and digital video content.
The role involves creating engaging visual content for Delhivery's brand and marketing initiatives, from shooting on-ground stories and brand films to producing advertisements, social media videos and campaign content.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling the entire video production process independently, from setting up the camera and lighting to shooting, editing and delivering the final film.
Key Responsibilities
1. Video Shooting & Production
Independently shoot advertisements, brand films, corporate videos, social media content and documentary-style stories.
Operate professional cameras, mirrorless cameras and other video equipment.
Manage camera settings, framing, composition, camera movements and lighting.
Handle on-location shoots across offices, warehouses, operational facilities and outdoor locations.
Record quality audio and manage basic sound equipment.
Plan and execute shoots with minimal supervision.
2. Video Editing & Post-Production
Edit videos for different platforms and formats, including YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and digital advertising.
Create engaging edits with strong storytelling, pacing, transitions and visual flow.
Perform basic colour correction, colour grading, sound mixing and audio enhancement.
Create titles, subtitles, graphics and basic motion graphics.
Adapt long-form footage into short-form videos, reels and advertisements.
Deliver final videos in the required aspect ratios, resolutions and formats.
3. Creative Collaboration
Work with the Brand and Marketing teams to translate creative briefs into effective video content.
Contribute ideas on visual storytelling, camera treatments and editing styles.
Collaborate with internal teams, employees and external production partners during shoots.
Stay updated on emerging video production techniques, equipment and editing trends.
Skills & Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in videography, video production and editing.
Strong hands-on experience in shooting and editing videos independently.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
Working knowledge of After Effects is an advantage.
Good understanding of cameras, lenses, lighting, audio recording and composition.

What We Are Looking For
Someone who loves being behind the camera as much as being in the editing room.
A strong visual sense and an eye for detail.
Someone who can independently take ownership of a video assignment from shoot to final edit.
A practical, resourceful individual who can produce quality content without always depending on large production crews.
A portfolio demonstrating actual shooting and editing work is essential.

Job Description
Role Objective
The objective of this team is to identify, onboard, and grow premium, high-CFT and trending
outlets on Dineout, with a strong focus on being the first mover in acquiring high-potential
restaurants before competitors such as District.
The team will initially focus on premium outlet acquisition and onboarding, with a long-term
mandate to also own account management, GOV growth, market share, and exclusive
campaigns/events for these strategic accounts.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)
1. Identify Premium High-Potential Outlets
Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets.
Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull.
Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance.
Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands.
2. Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets
Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout.
Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage.
Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities.
3. First-Mover Advantage
Ensure Dineout is the first mover in onboarding high-value premium outlets, wherever possible.
Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors.
Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships.
Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding.
Long-Term Scope of the Team
The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic
premium accounts.
1. Account Management
Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them.
Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners.
Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding.
Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution.
2. Drive GOV Growth Market Share
Own and drive GOV growth from the premium outlet portfolio.
Increase Dineouts market share within premium restaurant segments.
Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution.
3. Exclusive Campaigns Events
Identify premium partners suitable for exclusive campaigns, partnerships, and events.
Work closely with internal teams to conceptualize and execute differentiated campaigns.
Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners.
Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineouts proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners.
Key Success Metrics
The performance of the team can be evaluated through:
Number and quality of premium/high-CFT outlets identified.
Premium outlet onboarding rate.
Reduction in Z-Gaps.
First-mover onboarding rate versus competitors.
GOV generated from newly onboarded premium outlets.
GOV growth from managed accounts.
Dineout market share within the premium outlet segment.
Number and quality of exclusive campaigns/events launched. Qualifications
Strong business development and sales orientation.
Ability to identify and pursue high-value opportunities proactively.
Strong understanding of the premium restaurant/FB ecosystem.
Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
Ability to work with data and identify business opportunities.
Ability to transition from pure acquisition into strategic account management

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will develop and implement hygiene protocols and procedures to ensure all areas of the hotel meet the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene and comply with health and safety regulations. As an Assistant Manager Hygiene, you re not just ensuring cleanliness and hygiene - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft).
Manager: Minimum of 3 years in a hygiene management role, preferably in the hospitality industry.
Assistant Manager: Minimum of 2-3 years in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry, with a preference for supervisory or management positions
Supervisor: 2-3 years of experience in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry.
Excellent reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Strategic Planning Compliance: Develop hygiene policies and ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards.
Team Leadership Training: Lead the hygiene team and provide ongoing training to maintain performance and standards.
Cleaning Expertise: Apply knowledge of cleaning procedures, chemicals, and equipment to ensure effective practices.
Quality Assurance: Monitor cleanliness and hygiene levels, implementing quality control measures across all areas.
Budget Resource Management: Oversee hygiene supply budgets and ensure efficient use of resources.
Issue Resolution: Address hygiene-related concerns promptly to maintain a safe and sanitary environment.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will support the Chief Engineer / Assistant Chief Engineer in ensuring the smooth operation of all engineering functions, including hotel systems, plant and equipment, team management, sub-contractors, and maintenance of property structure and assets. As an Engineering Supervisor / Team Leader, you re not just overseeing the daily operations of physical building and systems maintenance and repairs - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous
Must have sound general Engineering knowledge and trade background
At least 5 years in a Service Technician position or similar position with working experience in a 5-star hotel.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Ensure facility safety and compliance: Support the maintenance of the hotel s buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, HVAC, and life safety systems, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations
Supervise maintenance operations: Assign and oversee daily maintenance tasks, ensuring thorough documentation of completed work in the property management system.
Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
Oversee contractor work: Supervise external contractors and inspect completed work for quality and compliance
Respond to service requests: Ensure maintenance requests, guest concerns, and emergency situations are addressed promptly and efficiently
Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
Equipment Maintenance Efficiency: Repair and maintain all hotel systems and equipment, ensuring efficiency and informing management about deficiencies and stock control needs.
Cost Management: Adhere to departmental operating expenses, evaluate products for reuse, monitor stock levels, and ensure the operation runs according to budgets and profit margins.

Description:
Manages all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection.
Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation.
Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements.
Assists in leading the emergency response team for all facility issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 1 year experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets
- Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems.
- Ensures regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
- Manages and controls heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations.
- Develops specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs.
- Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion.
- Oversees and directs the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities.
- Develops a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan.
- Develops project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs.
- Contacts contractors for bids and supervising construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.
- Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors.
- Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
- Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition.
- Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction.
- Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.
- Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
- Selects and orders or purchasing new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.
Maintaining Property Standards
- Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.
- Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.
- Strives to improve service performance.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements

Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Job Summary

Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.

Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management

Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.

Functional Competencies: Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Functional Competencies: Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.

- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
